title: RL-Guided Temporal Localization for Dual-Channel Retrieval in Long-Horizon Agent Memory

paragraphs.en: Time-aware retrieval is crucial for long-horizon LLM agents to effectively leverage ever-growing long-term memory. Existing methods focus on lexical or semantic similarity, leading to target memories being crowded out by temporally mismatched yet semantically similar candidates. Even time-aware approaches inject temporal cues only during memory organization or answer generation, overlooking temporal constraints at the retrieval stage, where candidate selection occurs—the root cause of the displacement. Inspired by the temporal contiguity effect in human episodic memory, we propose TIDER ( T emporal I nterval-driven D ual-channel E vidence R etrieval), a time-aware agentic retrieval framework. Central to TIDER is a reinforcement learning (RL)-trained temporal interval locator that infers the temporal windows in which the evidence lies. RL optimizes window localization as a discrete, non-differentiable retrieval decision, using composite rewards to convert sparse answer supervision into fine-grained retrieval feedback. These temporal windows first define the temporal retrieval channel; the retrieved candidates are then merged with results from the semantic channel and reranked by proximity to the windows. This temporal grounding enables TIDER to retrieve temporally aligned evidence that would otherwise be drowned out by the volume of semantically similar yet temporally mismatched memories. With a lightweight 1.7B locator, TIDER achieves state-of-the-art accuracy on both long-horizon memory benchmarks—61.52% on LifeBench (+8.82%) and 78.96% on LoCoMo (+3.66%), which indicates that temporal cues are crucial for pinpointing target evidence amid a vast pool of semantically similar historical events in long-term daily-life memory.
paragraphs.zh: 对于长期视野的 LLM 智能体而言，时间感知检索至关重要，因为它能使其有效利用持续增长的长期记忆。 现有方法主要关注词汇或语义相似性，导致目标记忆被时间上不符但语义相似的候选记忆挤占。 即便是具备时间感知能力的方法，也仅在记忆组织或答案生成阶段引入时间线索，而忽略了检索阶段的时间约束——这一阶段正是候选记忆被选中的环节，也是记忆位移的根本原因。 受人类情景记忆中时间邻近效应启发，我们提出了 TIDER（T emporal I nterval-driven D ual-channel E vidence R etrieval），一个具备时间感知能力的智能体检索框架。 TIDER 的核心是一个通过强化学习（RL）训练的时间间隔定位器，用于推断证据所处的时间窗口。 强化学习将窗口定位优化为一个离散且不可微分的检索决策，并利用复合奖励将稀疏的答案监督转化为精细的检索反馈。 这些时间窗口首先定义了时间检索通道；随后，检索到的候选记忆会与语义通道的结果合并，并根据与时间窗口的接近程度进行重新排序。 这种时间锚定使 TIDER 能够检索出时间上对齐的证据，而这些证据在以往会被大量语义相似但时间不符的记忆所淹没。 TIDER 采用一个轻量级的 17 亿参数定位器，在两项长期记忆基准测试中均达到了当前最优准确率：LifeBench 为 61.52%（+8.82%），LoCoMo 为 78.96%（+3.66%）。这表明，在长期日常生活的海量语义相似历史事件中，时间线索对于精准定位目标证据至关重要。

paragraphs.en: In recent years, long-term personalized assistants powered by large language model agents have advanced rapidly [ 16 , 18 , 14 , 2 , 34 ] . Sustaining such long-horizon interactions requires a foundational capability: retrieving pertinent evidence from an ever-growing history of daily events to address user queries [ 5 , 10 ] . However, daily events are highly homogeneous in surface semantics— “had dinner with family” can recur hundreds of times within a year—and the cue that genuinely tells one occurrence from another is often when it took place. This makes time-aware retrieval the central bottleneck: the system must locate the right evidence among many semantically similar events recurring at different times. In long-horizon personalized memory benchmarks such as LifeBench [ 4 ] and ATM-Bench [ 17 ] , 80–90% of questions involve temporal expressions such as “what did I have for lunch after returning from Japan?” , making time-aware retrieval indispensable rather than incidental.
paragraphs.zh: 近年来，由大型语言模型智能体驱动的长期个性化助手取得了快速发展 [ 16 , 18 , 14 , 2 , 34 ] 。 维持此类长期互动需要一项基础能力：从不断增长的日常事件历史中检索相关证据，以回应用户查询 [ 5 , 10 ] 。 然而，日常事件在表层语义上高度相似——“与家人共进晚餐”这一事件一年内可能重复出现数百次——而真正区分不同事件的关键往往在于其发生的时间。 这使得时间感知检索成为核心瓶颈：系统必须从众多语义相似但发生在不同时间的事件中定位正确的证据。 在 LifeBench [ 4 ] 和 ATM-Bench [ 17 ] 等长期个性化记忆基准测试中，80%–90% 的问题都涉及时间表达，例如“我从日本回来后的午餐吃了什么？”，因此时间感知检索是不可或缺的，而非可有可无的。

paragraphs.en: Existing agentic memory systems incorporate temporal information mostly outside the retrieval stage. Some inject temporal cues during memory organization with timestamps, temporal knowledge graphs, or time-aware structures [ 11 , 21 , 26 ] ; others strengthen temporal reasoning during answer generation with neuro-symbolic reasoning, program solvers, or temporal operators [ 7 , 25 , 13 , 29 ] ; recent RL-based methods optimize memory operations or post-retrieval candidate filtering [ 31 , 27 , 6 ] . None of these methods addresses the root cause: once the correct evidence has been crowded out at retrieval, downstream reasoning and post-retrieval filtering can only operate on an incomplete or contaminated candidate set. Borrowing prior time-aware retrieval is also a poor fit: rule-based normalizers [ 33 ] fail on personal, fuzzy phrasings such as “the week of her birthday” , while time-sensitive encoders [ 1 , 28 , 20 ] couple temporal and semantic signals in one vector space, demanding extra supervision and degrading semantic recall. Long-term memory, therefore, calls for a retrieval-stage, query-adaptive temporal mechanism decoupled from the semantic encoder.
paragraphs.zh: 现有的智能体记忆系统大多在检索阶段之外引入时间信息。 一些系统在记忆组织过程中通过时间戳、时序知识图谱或时间感知结构注入时间线索 [ 11 , 21 , 26 ]；另一些则通过神经符号推理、程序求解器或时间算子，在答案生成阶段强化时序推理 [ 7 , 25 , 13 , 29 ]；近期的基于强化学习的方法则优化记忆操作或检索后的候选项过滤 [ 31 , 27 , 6]。 这些方法均未触及根本原因：一旦正确证据在检索阶段被挤出，下游推理和检索后过滤便只能基于不完整或受污染的候选集进行。 借鉴现有的时间感知检索方法同样并不适用：基于规则的归一化器 [ 33 ] 无法处理“她生日那周”这类个人化、模糊的表达；而时间敏感编码器 [ 1 , 28 , 20 ] 则将时序信号与语义信号耦合到同一向量空间中，既需要额外监督，又会降低语义召回效果。 因此，长期记忆需要一个在检索阶段运行、能自适应查询且与语义编码器解耦的时间机制。

paragraphs.en: Motivated by the temporal contiguity effect in human episodic memory, where retrieval is shaped by temporal distance as well as semantic association [ 9 ] , we propose TIDER ( T emporal I nterval-driven D ual-channel E vidence R etrieval), a time-aware agentic retrieval framework for long-term memory; the basic idea is illustrated in Figure 1 . TIDER decouples temporal cues from the semantic encoder and represents them as temporal windows at the retrieval stage. Central to TIDER is a temporal interval locator π θ \pi_{\theta} trained via reinforcement learning: given a query and a timeline summary, π θ \pi_{\theta} decides whether the query is time-sensitive and predicts the windows that contain the target evidence. Window localization is a discrete, non-differentiable decision, so we cast it as an RL problem. The predicted windows define an independent temporal retrieval channel, while the semantic retrieval channel runs in parallel. Results from the two channels are merged and reranked by their distance to the predicted windows, promoting temporally aligned evidence into the top- k k and suppressing semantically close but temporally mismatched distractors. π θ \pi_{\theta} is trained under a composite reward over temporal need, window localization, evidence coverage, and answer correctness. When the query is non-temporal, π θ \pi_{\theta} closes the temporal channel, and TIDER falls back to the semantic retrieval.
paragraphs.zh: 受人类情景记忆中时间邻近效应（即检索过程既受时间距离影响，也受语义关联影响 [9]）的启发，我们提出了 TIDER（T emporal I nterval-driven D ual-channel E vidence R etrieval），一个面向长期记忆的时间感知智能体检索框架；其基本思路如图 1 所示。 TIDER 将时间线索与语义编码器解耦，并在检索阶段将其表示为时间窗口。 TIDER 的核心是一个通过强化学习训练的时间间隔定位器 π θ \pi_{\theta}：给定一个查询和一条时间线摘要，π θ \pi_{\theta} 会判断该查询是否具有时间敏感性，并预测包含目标证据的时间窗口。 窗口定位是一个离散且不可微分的决策问题，因此我们将其建模为强化学习问题。 预测出的时间窗口定义了一个独立的时间检索通道，而语义检索通道则并行运行。 两个通道的结果会被合并，并根据其与预测时间窗口的距离进行重新排序，从而将时间上对齐的证据提升至前 k 位，同时抑制语义相近但时间不匹配的分心项。π θ \pi_{\theta} 的训练基于时间需求、窗口定位、证据覆盖和答案正确性构成的复合奖励函数。 当查询不涉及时间因素时，π θ \pi_{\theta} 会关闭时间通道，TIDER 则退化为语义检索模式。

paragraphs.en: We evaluate TIDER on LifeBench [ 4 ] and LoCoMo [ 15 ] , where it consistently outperforms prior agentic memory frameworks, time-aware retrieval methods, and temporal reasoning methods, with the largest gains on hard queries that require distinguishing semantically similar events recurring at different times. Our contributions are:
paragraphs.zh: 我们在 LifeBench [4] 和 LoCoMo [15] 上对 TIDER 进行了评估，结果表明，它在性能上始终优于先前的智能体记忆框架、时间感知检索方法以及时序推理方法，尤其在需要区分不同时间重复出现的语义相似事件的复杂查询中，其提升最为显著。我们的贡献包括：

paragraphs.en: A time-aware agentic retrieval framework for long-term memory. TIDER predicts query-adaptive temporal windows that define a temporal channel parallel to the semantic one, and reranks merged candidates by window distance, resolving the bottleneck that semantically similar events from different times are hard to distinguish at retrieval.
paragraphs.zh: 一种面向长期记忆的时间感知智能体检索框架。 TIDER 能够预测与查询自适应的时间窗口，这些时间窗口定义了一个与语义通道平行的时间通道，并通过窗口距离对合并后的候选项进行重新排序，从而解决了在检索时难以区分来自不同时间但语义相似的事件这一瓶颈问题。

paragraphs.en: A reinforcement-learning algorithm for training the temporal interval locator. Rewards over temporal need, window localization, evidence coverage, and answer correctness convert sparse answer-only supervision into fine-grained retrieval-stage feedback, enabling the locator to predict evidence-covering windows that improve downstream retrieval.

sents.en: A reinforcement-learning algorithm for training the temporal interval locator.
sents.zh: 一种用于训练时间间隔定位器的强化学习算法。

sents.en: Rewards over temporal need, window localization, evidence coverage, and answer correctness convert sparse answer-only supervision into fine-grained retrieval-stage feedback, enabling the locator to predict evidence-covering windows that improve downstream retrieval.
sents.zh: 基于时间需求、窗口定位、证据覆盖和答案正确性的奖励机制，将稀疏的答案唯一监督转化为精细的检索阶段反馈，使定位器能够预测可覆盖证据的窗口，从而提升下游检索效果。

paragraphs.en: State-of-the-art performance on long-horizon memory benchmarks. With only a 1.7B locator, TIDER reaches 61.52% on LifeBench ( + 8.82 % +8.82\% ) and 78.96% on LoCoMo ( + 3.66 % +3.66\% ), indicating that temporal cues are crucial for pinpointing target evidence amid a vast pool of semantically similar historical events in long-term daily-life memory.
paragraphs.zh: 在长时程记忆基准测试中实现当前最先进的性能。 TIDER 仅使用一个 17 亿参数的定位器，就在 LifeBench 上达到了 61.52%（+8.82%）和 LoCoMo 上达到了 78.96%（+3.66%），这表明时间线索对于在长期日常记忆中海量语义相似的历史事件中精准定位目标证据至关重要。

paragraphs.en: Long-term agentic memory is an active area of research for LLM agents. One line focuses on the organization of memories: MemGPT [ 19 ] virtualizes context paging, A-MEM [ 30 ] maintains a Zettelkasten-style dynamic index, Mem0 [ 5 ] and MemoryBank [ 35 ] extract and consolidate episodic facts, Zep [ 21 ] encodes events as a temporal knowledge graph with explicit validity intervals, and TiMem [ 11 ] builds a multi-granularity temporal tree. Another line applies reinforcement learning to memory operations: Memory-R1 [ 31 ] and Mem- α \alpha [ 27 ] train policies with GRPO [ 23 ] to decide when to create or update memory, while Memory-T1 [ 6 ] applies RL to multi-session temporal reasoning at the answer stage. All of these methods act either upstream of retrieval (deciding what to store and when to update) or downstream (filtering candidates after retrieval), and none directly optimizes the retrieval stage itself. TIDER fills this gap by applying reinforcement learning to the generation of retrieval-time temporal constraints rather than to memory operations or post-retrieval reasoning.
paragraphs.zh: 长期智能体记忆是大型语言模型智能体领域的活跃研究方向。 一条研究路线聚焦于记忆的组织方式：MemGPT [ 19 ] 实现了上下文分页的虚拟化，A-MEM [ 30 ] 维护了一个类似Zettelkasten的动态索引，Mem0 [ 5 ] 和 MemoryBank [ 35 ] 能够提取并整合事件性事实，Zep [ 21 ] 将事件编码为具有明确有效时间区间的时间知识图谱，而 TiMem [ 11 ] 则构建了一个多粒度时间树。 另一条研究路线则将强化学习应用于记忆操作：Memory-R1 [ 31 ] 和 Mem- α \alpha [ 27 ] 使用 GRPO [ 23 ] 训练策略，以决定何时创建或更新记忆；而 Memory-T1 [ 6 ] 则在回答阶段将强化学习应用于多会话的时间推理。 所有这些方法要么在检索之前发挥作用（决定存储什么以及何时更新），要么在检索之后发挥作用（过滤候选项），但没有一种方法直接优化检索阶段本身。 TIDER 通过将强化学习应用于检索时时间约束的生成，而非记忆操作或检索后的推理，填补了这一空白。

paragraphs.en: Conventional time-aware retrieval models temporal signals inside a vector space: TempRetriever [ 1 ] trains separate temporal and semantic encoders, TsContriever [ 28 ] trains a temporal query encoder with a temporal-need gate, TSM [ 8 ] merges multiple time-specifier-conditioned retrievers, and TimeR4 [ 20 ] trains temporal embedders or rerankers over temporal knowledge graphs. Coupling temporal and semantic signals within a single feature space requires large-scale temporal supervision and degrades semantic recall. Heuristic-based methods such as MRAG [ 33 ] instead split the query into temporal and semantic parts and rely on hand-crafted templates or date-distance scoring; they cannot parse relative or fuzzy personal-history phrasings such as “the week of her birthday” . In contrast, TIDER’s temporal windows live outside any vector space: the locator emits explicit temporal windows that constrain an independent temporal channel, leaving the semantic encoder untouched. A complementary line strengthens downstream temporal reasoning given retrieved evidence: TReMu [ 7 ] translates evidence into Python via neuro-symbolic reasoning, CoTime [ 29 ] uses SQL-style temporal operators, and NeSTR [ 13 ] performs neuro-symbolic abductive reasoning over symbolic temporal relations. These methods take the retrieved set as given and ask how to compute over it, while we ask the upstream question of whether the retrieved set covers the correct temporal windows at all .
paragraphs.zh: 传统的时敏检索模型在向量空间中处理时间信号：TempRetriever [ 1 ] 分别训练时间和语义编码器，TsContriever [ 28 ] 使用一个时间需求门训练时间查询编码器，TSM [ 8 ] 合并多个受时间指定符条件约束的检索器，而 TimeR4 [ 20 ] 则在时间知识图上训练时间嵌入器或重排序器。 在单一特征空间内耦合时间和语义信号需要大规模的时间监督，并且会降低语义召回率。 基于启发式的方法（如 MRAG [ 33 ]）则将查询拆分为时间和语义部分，并依赖人工设计的模板或日期距离评分；它们无法解析“她生日那周”这类相对或模糊的个人历史表述。 相比之下，TIDER 的时间窗口存在于任何向量空间之外：定位器会输出明确的时间窗口以约束一个独立的时间通道，而语义编码器则不受影响。 另一条互补路线则在给定检索证据后强化下游的时间推理能力：TReMu [ 7 ] 通过神经符号推理将证据转换为 Python 代码，CoTime [ 29 ] 使用类 SQL 的时间算子，而 NeSTR [ 13 ] 则对符号化的时间关系进行神经符号演绎推理。 这些方法将检索结果集视为既定前提，并研究如何对其进行计算；而我们则提出一个上游问题：检索结果集是否 вообще 覆盖了正确的时间窗口。

paragraphs.en: TIDER is a time-aware agentic retrieval framework for long-term memory QA that decouples temporal constraints from the semantic embedding space and expresses them as explicit temporal windows. The pipeline is built around a reinforcement-learned locator π θ \pi_{\theta} : given a query and a timeline summary, π θ \pi_{\theta} predicts the windows that contain the required evidence (Section 3.1 ). The predicted windows define an independent temporal channel that runs in parallel with the always-on semantic channel, and the merged candidates are reranked by their temporal distance to the predicted windows (Section 3.2 ). The locator is trained with a composite reward over temporal need, window localization, evidence coverage, and answer correctness (Section 3.3 ). When the query is non-temporal, π θ \pi_{\theta} closes the temporal channel, and TIDER falls back to the semantic retrieval.
paragraphs.zh: TIDER 是一种面向长期记忆问答的时间感知智能体检索框架，它将时间约束与语义嵌入空间解耦，并将其表示为明确的时间窗口。 该流程围绕一个通过强化学习训练的定位器 π θ \pi_{\theta} 构建：给定一个查询和时间线摘要，π θ \pi_{\theta} 会预测包含所需证据的窗口（第 3.1 节）。 预测的窗口定义了一个独立的时间通道，该通道与始终开启的语义通道并行运行，合并后的候选项会根据其与预测窗口的时间距离进行重新排序（第 3.2 节）。 定位器的训练基于复合奖励，涵盖时间需求、窗口定位、证据覆盖和答案正确性等方面（第 3.3 节）。 当查询不涉及时间时，π θ \pi_{\theta} 会关闭时间通道，TIDER 则回归到语义检索模式。

paragraphs.en: TIDER takes a user’s multi-turn dialogue history 𝒞 \mathcal{C} and a query q q as input, and produces an evidence set ℰ ^ \hat{\mathcal{E}} for a downstream LLM, which generates an answer a ^ \hat{a} conditioned on ℰ ^ \hat{\mathcal{E}} and compared against the gold answer a ∗ a^{*} . This subsection describes the two steps that turn 𝒞 \mathcal{C} into the inputs consumed at the retrieval stage: first, the dialogue is compressed into a temporally anchored event memory pool ℳ \mathcal{M} , then a locator π θ \pi_{\theta} rewrites the query’s temporal need into an explicit temporal localization z z .
paragraphs.zh: TIDER 以用户的多轮对话历史 𝒞 \mathcal{C} 和查询 q q 作为输入，为下游 LLM 生成一个证据集 ℰ ^ \hat{\mathcal{E}}；该 LLM 基于 ℰ ^ \hat{\mathcal{E}} 生成答案 a ^ \hat{a}，并与标准答案 a ∗ a^{*} 进行比较。 本小节描述了将 𝒞 \mathcal{C} 转换为检索阶段所需输入的两个步骤：首先，将对话压缩为具有时间锚定的事件记忆池 ℳ \mathcal{M}；然后，由定位器 π θ \pi_{\theta} 将查询中的时间需求改写为明确的时间定位 z z。

paragraphs.en: Implicit or relative temporal phrasings such as “the week of her birthday” or “after the last get-together” are hard to cover with rule templates and hurt semantic retrieval when forced into a shared embedding. We therefore introduce a locator π θ ( ⋅ ∣ q , 𝒮 q ) \pi_{\theta}(\cdot\mid q,\mathcal{S}_{q}) that takes the query q q together with a query-adaptive timeline summary 𝒮 q = { ( d i , s i ) } i ∈ 𝒩 q ⊆ ℳ \mathcal{S}_{q}=\{(d_{i},s_{i})\}_{i\in\mathcal{N}_{q}}\subseteq\mathcal{M} , and emits a structured temporal localization
paragraphs.zh: 像“她生日那周”或“上次聚会之后”这样的隐含性或相对性时间表达，很难用规则模板覆盖，而且当被强行纳入共享嵌入时，还会损害语义检索效果。 因此，我们引入一个定位器 π θ ( ⋅ ∣ q , 𝒮 q ) \pi_{\theta}(\cdot\mid q,\mathcal{S}_{q})，它接收查询 q 以及一个与查询自适应的时间线摘要 𝒮 q = { ( d i , s i ) } i ∈ 𝒩 q ⊆ ℳ \mathcal{S}_{q}=\{(d_{i},s_{i})\}_{i\in\mathcal{N}_{q}}\subseteq\mathcal{M}，并输出一个结构化的时间定位结果。

paragraphs.en: A finite annotated ( q , detect , W pred ) (q,\texttt{detect},W_{\text{pred}}) set covers neither the long tail of natural-language temporal phrasings nor the actual downstream retrieval and reasoning effects, so we adopt a two-stage scheme of SFT cold-start followed by GRPO online optimization: SFT aligns the locator to a fixed JSON schema and seeds an initial window guess, while GRPO uses R R as the policy-gradient signal to self-correct over end-to-end rollouts,
paragraphs.zh: 一个有限的带注释的 ( q , detect , W pred ) (q,\texttt{detect},W_{\text{pred}}) 集合既无法覆盖自然语言中时间表达的长尾现象，也无法反映实际的下游检索与推理效果，因此我们采用一种两阶段方案：首先进行 SFT 冷启动，随后执行 GRPO 在线优化；SFT 将定位器对齐到固定的 JSON 模式，并生成初始窗口猜测，而 GRPO 则使用 R R 作为策略梯度信号，通过端到端的展开过程实现自我修正。

paragraphs.en: Rollouts whose output cannot be parsed by the schema are clamped to R = R min R=R_{\text{min}} and skip the downstream judge; rollouts are U-shape difficulty-stratified by | W gold | |W_{\text{gold}}| .
paragraphs.zh: 无法通过模式解析其输出的展开结果将被钳制为 R = R_{\text{min}}，并跳过下游的评判环节；这些展开结果按 |W_{\text{gold}}| 进行 U 型难度分层。

paragraphs.en: LifeBench [ 4 ] is a benchmark for long-term, multi-source, fragmented personal memory that spans both declarative and non-declarative memory. It contains one-year synthetic personal histories for ten users, with on average roughly 13,000 entries per user and a total of 2,003 questions spanning five categories: Information Extraction (IE), Multi-hop Reasoning (MR), Nondeclarative Memory Reasoning (ND), Temporal and Knowledge Updating (TKU), and Unanswerable (UA); following the LoCoMo evaluation protocol, the Unanswerable category is excluded from evaluation.
paragraphs.zh: LifeBench [ 4 ] 是一项针对长期、多源且碎片化的个人记忆的基准测试，涵盖了陈述性记忆和非陈述性记忆。 该基准包含十位用户为期一年的合成个人历史，每位用户平均约有 13,000 条记录，并设有总计 2,003 个问题，覆盖五个类别：信息提取（IE）、多跳推理（MR）、非陈述性记忆推理（ND）、时间与知识更新（TKU）以及无法回答（UA）；根据 LoCoMo 评估协议，无法回答类别不参与评估。

paragraphs.en: LoCoMo [ 15 ] focuses on extremely long multi-session dialogues with QA spanning five reasoning categories—single-hop, multi-hop, temporal, open-domain, and adversarial; following prior work, we evaluate on its 1,540-question subset excluding the adversarial category. Expanded benchmark descriptions and evaluation protocols are provided in Appendix A .

paragraphs.en: We compare against three families of baselines; aside from Oracle, all methods share the same downstream answer model and top- k k retrieval budget. Agentic memory frameworks: MemOS [ 12 ] is a memory operating system that builds unified mechanisms across parametric, activation, and plaintext memory types; TiMem [ 11 ] is a temporal-hierarchical memory framework that consolidates conversations into a temporal memory tree for long-horizon agents; Zep [ 21 ] is a memory layer service for LLM agents that synthesizes history into a temporally-aware knowledge graph; Mem0 [ 5 ] is a memory-centric architecture that extracts, consolidates, and retrieves salient information from ongoing conversations. Time-aware retrieval: TsContriever [ 28 ] applies supervised contrastive learning with temporally-constrained negatives to fine-tune the query encoder, routing queries through a classifier to handle temporal constraints. Temporal reasoning: NeSTR [ 13 ] performs neuro-symbolic abductive reasoning over symbolic temporal representations with reflection and consistency checking. We do not include training-based temporal-reasoning methods such as Memory-T1 [ 6 ] as direct baselines, since they fine-tune the response model, whereas our evaluation keeps the downstream LLM fixed across methods. We additionally report Oracle , which directly provides the gold-evidence context, as a non-comparable upper bound.
paragraphs.zh: 我们将方法与三组基线方法进行了对比；除了 Oracle 之外，所有方法都共享相同的下游答案模型和 top-k k 检索预算。 智能体记忆框架：MemOS [ 12 ] 是一种记忆操作系统，它在参数化记忆、激活记忆和纯文本记忆类型之间构建了统一的机制；TiMem [ 11 ] 是一种时间层次记忆框架，它将对话整合为时间记忆树，以服务于长期规划的智能体；Zep [ 21 ] 是为 LLM 智能体提供的记忆层服务，它能将历史信息合成一个具有时间意识的知识图谱；Mem0 [ 5 ] 是一种以记忆为核心的架构，能够从持续对话中提取、整合和检索关键信息。 时间感知检索：TsContriever [ 28 ] 采用带有时间约束负样本的监督对比学习来微调查询编码器，并通过分类器路由查询以处理时间约束。 时间推理：NeSTR [ 13 ] 基于符号化的时间表示，结合反思和一致性检查执行神经符号演绎推理。 我们没有将基于训练的时间推理方法（如 Memory-T1 [ 6 ]）作为直接基线纳入比较，因为这些方法会微调响应模型，而我们的评估在所有方法中均保持下游 LLM 固定不变。 此外，我们还报告了 Oracle 的结果，它直接提供黄金证据上下文，作为一个不可比较的上限。

paragraphs.en: On LifeBench (Table 1 , 408 questions) and LoCoMo (Table 2 , 1,540 questions), TIDER simultaneously attains the best overall accuracy: 61.52 % on LifeBench (second-best NeSTR 52.70%, + 8.82 +8.82 %) and 78.96 % on LoCoMo (second-best TiMem 75.30%, + 3.66 +3.66 %); the locator is only 1.7B , far smaller than the shared downstream answer models GPT-5-mini / GPT-4o-mini, confirming that the gain comes from a structured retrieval-time temporal localization rather than from a stronger response model. Compared with agentic-memory frameworks (MemOS, TiMem, Zep, and Mem0), TIDER achieves the best performance on both datasets. On LifeBench, it outperforms the strongest baseline in this group, Mem0 (51.80%), by 9.72%; on LoCoMo, it surpasses the strongest baseline in this group, TiMem (75.30%), by 3.66%. The time-aware retriever TsContriever performs poorly on both datasets, with a substantially larger gap to TIDER on LifeBench than on LoCoMo. This result supports the concern raised in § 1 : coupling temporal and semantic signals in a shared representation space can weaken semantic recall, especially in large-scale long-term memory settings such as LifeBench, where relative and indirect temporal expressions are more prevalent and place greater stress on encoder-fused retrieval. As a temporal reasoning baseline, NeSTR processes temporal information at the answer stage rather than during retrieval. It underperforms TIDER by 8.82% and 5.48% on LifeBench and LoCoMo, respectively, highlighting the importance of addressing temporal mismatch before evidence enters the downstream context. The effectiveness of TIDER stems from its dual-channel retrieval architecture with explicit window constraints: by moving temporal constraints upstream into the retrieval stage as an explicit window, TIDER suppresses semantically similar but temporally mismatched candidates without degrading semantic recall, offering a structural advantage over both embedding-stage temporal supervision and reasoning-stage post-processing.
paragraphs.zh: 在 LifeBench（表 1，408 个问题）和 LoCoMo（表 2，1,540 个问题）上，TIDER 同时实现了最高的整体准确率：LifeBench 上的准确率为 61.52%（次优的 NeSTR 为 52.70%，+8.82%），LoCoMo 上的准确率为 78.96%（次优的 TiMem 为 75.30%，+3.66%）；其定位器模型仅含 1.7B 参数，远小于共享下游答案模型的 GPT-5-mini / GPT-4o-mini，这证实了性能提升源于结构化的检索时态定位，而非更强大的响应模型。 与智能体记忆框架（MemOS、TiMem、Zep 和 Mem0）相比，TIDER 在两个数据集上都取得了最佳性能。 在 LifeBench 上，它比该组中最强的基线模型 Mem0（51.80%）高出 9.72%；在 LoCoMo 上，它比该组中最强的基线模型 TiMem（75.30%）高出 3.66%。 时态感知检索器 TsContriever 在两个数据集上的表现均不佳，且与 TIDER 的差距在 LifeBench 上明显大于 LoCoMo。 这一结果支持了 §1 中提出的担忧：将时态信号和语义信号耦合到共享表示空间中可能会削弱语义召回能力，尤其是在 LifeBench 这类大规模长期记忆场景中，相对和间接的时态表达更为普遍，对编码器融合后的检索能力提出了更高要求。 作为时态推理基线模型，NeSTR 在回答阶段而非检索阶段处理时态信息。 它在 LifeBench 和 LoCoMo 上的表现分别比 TIDER 低 8.82% 和 5.48%，凸显了在证据进入下游上下文之前解决时态不匹配问题的重要性。 TIDER 的有效性源于其具有显式窗口约束的双通道检索架构：通过将时态约束提前到检索阶段作为显式窗口，TIDER 能够在不损害语义召回能力的情况下抑制语义相似但时态不匹配候选项，从而在结构上优于嵌入阶段的时态监督与推理阶段的后处理方法。

sents.en: It underperforms TIDER by 8.82% and 5.48% on LifeBench and LoCoMo, respectively, highlighting the importance of addressing temporal mismatch before evidence enters the downstream context.

sents.en: The effectiveness of TIDER stems from its dual-channel retrieval architecture with explicit window constraints: by moving temporal constraints upstream into the retrieval stage as an explicit window, TIDER suppresses semantically similar but temporally mismatched candidates without degrading semantic recall, offering a structural advantage over both embedding-stage temporal supervision and reasoning-stage post-processing.
sents.zh: TIDER 的有效性源于其具有显式窗口约束的双通道检索架构：通过将时态约束提前到检索阶段作为显式窗口，TIDER 能够在不损害语义召回能力的情况下抑制语义相似但时态不匹配候选项，从而在结构上优于嵌入阶段的时态监督与推理阶段的后处理方法。

paragraphs.en: Although TIDER achieves the highest overall accuracy on LoCoMo, its Temporal accuracy and token-level F1 are slightly below TiMem’s. Our analysis suggests this gap stems from cross-dataset window-localization mismatch on LoCoMo’s sparser timeline: predicted windows cover 76.25% of gold dates, compared with 93.77% on LifeBench. Using oracle windows raises Temporal accuracy from 71.65% to 79.13% and F1 from 51.72% to 57.83%, surpassing TiMem on both.
paragraphs.zh: 尽管 TIDER 在 LoCoMo 数据集上实现了最高的整体准确率，但其时间维度的准确率和词元级 F1 值略低于 TiMem。 我们的分析表明，这一差距源于 LoCoMo 较稀疏的时间线上跨数据集的窗口定位不匹配：预测窗口覆盖了真实日期的 76.25%，而 LifeBench 上的覆盖率为 93.77%。 使用理想窗口后，时间维度的准确率从 71.65% 提升至 79.13%，F1 值从 51.72% 提升至 57.83%，在两项指标上均超越了 TiMem。

paragraphs.en: To unpack overall accuracy by question type, we stratify the 408 LifeBench questions into four categories (Fig. 3 ). Time-independent queries form the non-temporal category. For the remaining questions, we segment gold-evidence dates into temporal windows, where any gap of at least three days starts a new window, and group them into single-window , dual-window , and multi-window categories by window count. As shown in Fig. 3 , TIDER attains the best accuracy in every category. On non-temporal queries, its margin over the next-best baseline is only 0.67 % 0.67\% , suggesting that closing the temporal channel does not hurt pure semantic recall. Across the three temporal categories, TIDER improves over the strongest baseline by 9.78 9.78 % on average, with the largest gains arising when evidence must be localized across separated temporal windows (+14.8%), suggesting that long-horizon agent memory benefits from treating temporal cues as an independent retrieval dimension rather than folding them into semantic similarity. Appendix F provides more detailed analysis results with standard deviations. Appendix G.2 provides case studies from different temporal categories, illustrating how baselines can retrieve same-entity events from the wrong time, miss one of two required temporal anchors, or fall back to long-running persona facts, whereas TIDER recovers the correct evidence from long-term memory.
paragraphs.zh: 为按问题类型解析整体准确率，我们将 LifeBench 的 408 个问题分为四类（图 3）。 与时间无关的查询构成非时间类别。 对于其余问题，我们将黄金证据中的日期划分为时间窗口，其中任何至少间隔三天的空白都会开启一个新窗口，并根据窗口数量将其归为单窗口、双窗口和多窗口类别。 如图 3 所示，TIDER 在所有类别中均实现了最高的准确率。 在非时间查询上，其相对于次优基线的准确率提升仅为 0.67%（0.67\%），这表明关闭时间通道并不会损害纯粹的语义召回能力。 在三个时间类别中，TIDER 的平均准确率比最强的基线提升了 9.78%（9.78%），其中最大的提升出现在证据必须跨越分离的时间窗口定位时（+14.8%），这表明长期智能体记忆从将时间线索视为独立的检索维度而非将其融入语义相似性中获得了益处。 附录 F 提供了包含标准差的更详细分析结果。 附录 G.2 提供了来自不同时间类别的案例研究，展示了基线模型如何可能从错误的时间点检索同一实体的事件、遗漏两个必要时间锚点中的某一个，或退而使用长期存在的人物设定事实，而 TIDER 则能从长期记忆中恢复正确的证据。

paragraphs.en: Table 3 reports cumulative ablations of TIDER’s main components. Overall accuracy decreases monotonically from 61.52 % 61.52\% to 51.45 % 51.45\% as we remove the distance-decay reranker, the temporal channel, and the timeline summary 𝒮 q \mathcal{S}_{q} . Removing the distance-decay reranker reduces Overall accuracy by 3.92 % 3.92\% , with the largest drop on the time-sensitive TKU category ( 6.53 % 6.53\% ), which is especially sensitive to temporal alignment. Further removing the temporal channel yields an additional 5.39 % 5.39\% drop, while removing 𝒮 q \mathcal{S}_{q} from the remaining semantic-only setting accounts for another 0.76 % 0.76\% . F1 shows a non-monotonic trend: removing the temporal channel reduces F1 by 19.40 19.40 points, while further removing 𝒮 q \mathcal{S}_{q} recovers 15.43 15.43 points. This suggests that the timeline summary is most effective when paired with the temporal channel; without temporal constraints, it can introduce noisy context that hurts token-level matching. Overall, TIDER’s gains arise from the coupled operation of the temporal interval locator, the dual-channel retriever, and the distance-decay reranker, rather than from any single component in isolation.
paragraphs.zh: 表3报告了TIDER主要组件的累积消融结果。 随着我们移除距离衰减重排序器、时间通道和时间线摘要𝒮 q \mathcal{S}_{q}，整体准确率从61.52 % 61.52\%单调下降至51.45 % 51.45\%。 移除距离衰减重排序器使整体准确率下降3.92 % 3.92\%，其中对时间敏感的TKU类别下降幅度最大（6.53 % 6.53\%），该类别尤其对时间对齐敏感。 进一步移除时间通道导致额外下降5.39 % 5.39\%，而在仅保留语义的剩余设置中，移除𝒮 q \mathcal{S}_{q}又导致0.76 % 0.76\%的下降。 F1值呈现出非单调趋势：移除时间通道使F1值下降19.40点，而进一步移除𝒮 q \mathcal{S}_{q}则使其回升15.43点。 这表明时间线摘要在与时间通道结合使用时效果最佳；若缺乏时间约束，它可能会引入噪声上下文，从而损害词元级别的匹配效果。 总体而言，TIDER的性能提升源于时间区间定位器、双通道检索器和距离衰减重排序器的协同作用，而非任何单一组件的独立贡献。

paragraphs.en: To separate temporal retrieval gains from memory construction, we cross two memory representations with two retrieval methods while keeping all other settings fixed. TIDER improves Overall accuracy over semantic-only retrieval by 8.09% on flat fixed chunks and 9.31% on the full memory pool. Full memory construction adds 1.72% and 2.94% under semantic-only and TIDER retrieval, respectively. These results indicate that TIDER’s gains come primarily from temporal retrieval rather than memory construction. The complete factorial comparison is provided in Appendix D.2 .
paragraphs.zh: 为了将时间检索带来的增益与记忆构建区分开来，我们在保持所有其他设置不变的前提下，将两种记忆表示与两种检索方法进行了交叉组合。 在固定扁平分块上，TIDER 的整体准确率比仅基于语义的检索提升了 8.09%；在完整记忆池中，这一提升幅度为 9.31%。 在仅基于语义的检索和 TIDER 检索中，完整的记忆构建分别带来了 1.72% 和 2.94% 的提升。 这些结果表明，TIDER 的增益主要源于时间检索，而非记忆构建。 完整的因子组合对比结果见附录 D.2。

paragraphs.en: We also ablate the reward components while keeping the remaining training and retrieval pipeline fixed. Jointly removing the detection reward r det r_{\text{det}} and window-localization reward r win r_{\text{win}} reduces Overall accuracy by 5.64% and TKU accuracy by 15.22%. Removing the outcome reward r out r_{\text{out}} or evidence reward r evd r_{\text{evd}} reduces Overall accuracy by 2.45% or 1.96%, respectively. These results show that the detection and window-localization rewards are particularly important for learning effective temporal retrieval, especially on time-sensitive questions. Detailed results are reported in Appendix C.6 .

paragraphs.en: We isolate the locator by fixing the dual-channel retriever and distance-decay reranker (Fig. 4 ). Removing GRPO from the Qwen3-1.7B locator drops Overall to 55.64 % 55.64\% ( − 5.88 % -5.88\% , with the largest loss on TKU at − 13.05 % -13.05\% ), while the zero-shot Qwen3-1.7B locator reaches only 53.19 % 53.19\% , barely above the No-Temporal lower bound ( + 0.98 % +0.98\% ), confirming that the temporal path requires a trained window policy. A much larger GPT-5.2 zero-shot locator improves to 57.84 % 57.84\% but remains − 3.68 % -3.68\% below TIDER, showing scale alone cannot replace reward-optimized temporal localization. Conversely, an Oracle Window upper bound ( W gold W_{\text{gold}} ) adds only + 1.70 % +1.70\% Overall because TIDER’s predicted windows already cover 93.77 % 93.77\% of gold dates. These results indicate the temporal path provides the structural capacity, while GRPO learns the window-alignment policy needed to activate it.

paragraphs.en: In this work, we introduced TIDER , a time-aware agentic retrieval framework that addresses temporal-mismatch failures at retrieval time, where correct evidence is buried by semantically similar yet temporally mismatched candidates before any downstream reasoner can act on it. At the core of TIDER is a query-adaptive temporal interval locator, decoupled from the semantic encoder, that emits explicit temporal windows. These windows define a parallel temporal channel, whose candidates are merged with semantic candidates and reranked by temporal distance, suppressing temporally mismatched distractors while preserving semantic recall. The locator is trained via GRPO, with a composite reward that balances temporal need, window localization, evidence coverage, and answer correctness. Extensive evaluation on LifeBench and LoCoMo shows that TIDER attains state-of-the-art accuracy with only a 1.7B locator, and locator-substitution analysis confirms that the gain comes from retrieval-time temporal constraints rather than model scale. These results suggest temporal cues are crucial for pinpointing target evidence amid a vast pool of semantically similar historical events in long-term daily-life memory. We discuss limitations and broader impact in Appendix I .
paragraphs.zh: 在这项工作中，我们提出了 TIDER——一个具备时间感知能力的智能体检索框架，旨在解决检索时出现的时间不匹配问题：在下游推理器采取行动之前，正确的证据会被语义相似但时间不匹配的候选项所掩盖。 TIDER 的核心是一个可自适应查询的时间区间定位器，它与语义编码器解耦，能够输出明确的时间窗口。 这些时间窗口定义了一个平行的时间通道，其候选项会与语义候选项合并，并通过时间距离进行重新排序，从而抑制时间不匹配的干扰项，同时保留语义召回能力。 该定位器通过 GRPO 进行训练，其复合奖励函数平衡了时间需求、窗口定位、证据覆盖和答案正确性等多个因素。 在 LifeBench 和 LoCoMo 上的广泛评估表明，TIDER 仅使用一个 17 亿参数的定位器便实现了当前最先进的准确率；而定位器替换分析也证实，性能提升源于检索时施加的时间约束，而非模型规模。 这些结果表明，在长期日常记忆中海量语义相似的历史事件中精准定位目标证据时，时间线索起着至关重要的作用。 我们在附录 I 中讨论了本研究的局限性及其更广泛的影响。

paragraphs.en: This appendix describes the two long-horizon memory benchmarks used in our evaluation, the categories they expose, the train / evaluation splits we adopt, and the metrics under which all systems are compared.
paragraphs.zh: 本附录介绍了我们评估中使用的两个长期记忆基准测试、它们所涵盖的类别、我们采用的训练/评估划分，以及所有系统均依据这些指标进行比较。

paragraphs.en: LifeBench [ 4 ] is a long-horizon multi-source personalized memory benchmark designed to stress-test memory systems beyond chat-only settings. It contains synthetic year-long personal histories for ten users ( user-0 through user-9 ), with on average roughly 13,000 13{,}000 entries per user. Each user trace integrates multi-source daily traces—multi-session chat dialogues, phone-operation logs, trip and location histories, exercise and health-tracking records, and free-form personal notes—generated through an anonymized-persona-driven simulator with explicit temporal anchoring and cross-source consistency checks, so semantically similar events recur across the year and force the memory system to disambiguate by time and context. Questions span five categories—Information Extraction (IE), Multi-hop Reasoning (MR), Nondeclarative Memory Reasoning (ND), Temporal and Knowledge Updating (TKU), and Unanswerable (UA)—summing to 2,003 2{,}003 items in total, and are answered open-endedly under an LLM-as-judge protocol with GPT-5-mini. State-of-the-art memory systems that score around 90 % 90\% on prior chat-only benchmarks (e.g., LoCoMo, LongMemEval) drop to 55 % 55\% overall on LifeBench, confirming that multi-source temporal personal histories pose a substantially harder retrieval and reasoning challenge. Following the LoCoMo evaluation protocol, we exclude UA, which leaves 1,931 1{,}931 effective questions. We evaluate on the user-0 / user-1 split ( 408 408 questions after UA exclusion) and synthesize training samples from user-2 through user-9, so the training and evaluation users on LifeBench are disjoint.
paragraphs.zh: LifeBench [ 4 ] 是一项长期多源个性化记忆基准测试，旨在对记忆系统进行全面压力测试，使其超越仅支持聊天的场景。 它包含十位用户（user-0 到 user-9）为期一年的合成个人历史，每位用户的条目平均约为 13,000 个。 每位用户的轨迹都整合了多源日常数据——包括多会话聊天对话、手机操作日志、行程与位置历史、运动与健康追踪记录以及自由形式的个人笔记——这些数据通过一个基于匿名化人物设定的模拟器生成，并带有明确的时间锚定和跨源一致性检查，从而确保语义相似的事件在整年中重复出现，迫使记忆系统通过时间和上下文进行消歧。 问题涵盖五个类别——信息提取（IE）、多跳推理（MR）、非陈述性记忆推理（ND）、时间与知识更新（TKU）以及无法回答的问题（UA），总计 2,003 个问题，这些问题在“大语言模型作为评判者”的协议下由 GPT-5-mini 进行开放式回答。 在以往的仅支持聊天的基准测试中得分约 90% 的顶尖记忆系统（例如 LoCoMo、LongMemEval），在 LifeBench 上的整体得分降至 55%，这证实了多源时间序列个人历史所带来的检索与推理挑战要困难得多。 遵循 LoCoMo 评估协议，我们排除了 UA 类别，因此剩余 1,931 个有效问题。 我们在 user-0 / user-1 分组上进行评估（排除 UA 后共有 408 个问题），并从 user-2 到 user-9 合成训练样本，因此 LifeBench 中的训练用户和评估用户互不重叠。

paragraphs.en: LoCoMo [ 15 ] is a benchmark for very long-term conversational memory: each instance is a multi-session dialogue between two persona-grounded agents that, on average, spans 600 600 turns and 16 16 K tokens across up to 32 32 sessions, far exceeding the five-session horizon of prior long-term-dialogue benchmarks. The dialogues are produced by a machine–human pipeline that grounds the speakers in personas and a temporal event graph, with optional image sharing for multi-modal turns and human annotators verifying long-range consistency and event-graph faithfulness. The associated QA benchmark covers five reasoning categories—single-hop, multi-hop, temporal, open-domain, and adversarial—and was designed to expose the difficulty of comprehending long-range temporal and causal dynamics within dialogues. Following prior work, we evaluate on the 1,540 1{,}540 -question subset after excluding the adversarial category. LoCoMo serves as a zero-shot generalization test: no LoCoMo conversations or questions enter our training pipeline.

paragraphs.en: We evaluate all systems with the official end-to-end question-answering protocol of LoCoMo [ 15 ] and LifeBench [ 4 ] : Accuracy and F1 . This subsection gives the precise definitions and explains why we do not report classical retrieval-side metrics such as Recall@ k k as headline numbers.
paragraphs.zh: 我们使用 LoCoMo [ 15 ] 和 LifeBench [ 4 ] 的官方端到端问答协议来评估所有系统：准确率和 F1 值。 本小节给出了精确的定义，并解释了为何我们不将经典检索侧指标（如 Recall@k）作为主要结果进行报告。

sents.zh: 我们使用 LoCoMo [ 15 ] 和 LifeBench [ 4 ] 的官方端到端问答协议来评估所有系统：准确率和 F1 值。

paragraphs.en: For each question q q with gold answer a ∗ a^{*} and predicted answer a ^ \hat{a} , we obtain a binary correctness score Acc ⁡ ( q ) ∈ { 0 , 1 } \mathrm{Acc}(q)\in\{0,1\} via the official locomo_grader judge prompt (Appendix J.3 ). To suppress single-evaluation variance, we invoke the same judge prompt three independent times and adopt the majority vote ( ≥ 2 / 3 \geq 2/3 correct ) as the final label, matching the r out r_{\text{out}} definition used during GRPO training (Eq. 11 ). The judge model is GPT-5-mini on LifeBench and GPT-4o-mini on LoCoMo, fixed across all baselines for fairness; cross-judge variance is audited in Appendix J.6 . Answer generation, in contrast, is dataset-specific—LifeBench follows its official QA_PROMPT and LoCoMo follows the Mem0-style ANSWER_PROMPT_MEM0 , both reproduced verbatim in Appendix J.3 .
paragraphs.zh: 对于每个具有标准答案 a* 和预测答案 a^ 的问题 q，我们通过官方的 locomo_grader 判题提示（附录 J.3）获得一个二元正确性得分 Acc(q) ∈ {0,1}。 为了抑制单次评估的方差，我们将相同的判题提示独立调用三次，并采用多数投票（≥ 2/3 正确）作为最终标签，这与 GRPO 训练期间使用的 r_out 定义（公式 11）一致。 判题模型在 LifeBench 上为 GPT-5-mini，在 LoCoMo 上为 GPT-4o-mini，为保持公平性，所有基线方法均使用相同的模型；跨判题模型的方差在附录 J.6 中进行了审计。 相比之下，答案生成是数据集特定的——LifeBench 遵循其官方的 QA_PROMPT，而 LoCoMo 则遵循 Mem0 风格的 ANSWER_PROMPT_MEM0，两者均在附录 J.3 中完整复现。

paragraphs.en: F1 is the token-level harmonic mean of precision and recall between the normalised prediction a ^ ~ \tilde{\hat{a}} and the normalised gold a ∗ ~ \tilde{a^{*}} , following the standard preprocessing inherited by the LoCoMo reference implementation: lowercasing, article and punctuation removal, and white-space tokenisation.
paragraphs.zh: F1 是归一化预测值 a ^ ~ \tilde{\hat{a}} 与归一化黄金标准值 a ∗ ~ \tilde{a^{*}} 之间的精确率和召回率的词元级调和平均值，遵循 LoCoMo 参考实现所继承的标准预处理流程：小写化、移除冠词和标点符号，以及按空白符进行词元分割。

paragraphs.en: Conventional IR metrics presuppose a canonical evidence unit shared across all systems, against which gold relevance labels can be defined uniformly. The agentic-memory baselines we compare against, as well as TIDER itself, do not consume raw conversations directly: each system ingests the raw data and emits a method-specific memory representation through compression, extraction, or rewriting. These resulting units differ substantially in granularity—from temporally anchored event clusters in TIDER’s memory pool ℳ \mathcal{M} (Eq. 1 ), to session-level summaries in TiMem [ 11 ] and MemoryBank [ 35 ] , per-utterance dense chunks in TsContriever [ 28 ] , and temporal knowledge-graph triples in Zep [ 21 ] . Consequently, top- k k retrieval results are not directly comparable across systems: a top- k k set of summaries covers substantially more raw evidence than a top- k k set of utterances, and there is no principled normalization that aligns these heterogeneous units. Forcing a single unit, such as raw utterances, would penalize systems whose designs intentionally rewrite or condense memory, thereby conflating memory-construction choices with retrieval quality. We therefore follow the convention established by LoCoMo and LifeBench and evaluate all systems using the same downstream task performance metrics: QA accuracy and F1.
paragraphs.zh: 传统的检索（IR）指标预设了所有系统共享的标准证据单元，基于该单元可以统一定义黄金相关标签。 我们用于对比的智能体记忆基线模型以及 TIDER 本身，都不会直接消耗原始对话：每个系统都会摄入原始数据，并通过压缩、提取或重写的方式生成特定于其方法的记忆表示。 这些生成的单元在粒度上存在显著差异——从 TIDER 的记忆池 ℳ \mathcal{M}（公式 1）中带有时间锚点的事件集群，到 TiMem [11] 和 MemoryBank [35] 中的会话级摘要，TsContriever [28] 中的逐发言密集片段，以及 Zep [21] 中的时序知识图谱三元组。 因此，各系统的前 k 个检索结果无法直接比较：一个前 k 个摘要的集合所覆盖的原始证据量远多于一个前 k 个发言的集合，且不存在能够对齐这些异构单元的系统性归一化方法。 如果强行采用单一单元（如原始发言），则会惩罚那些有意对记忆进行重写或压缩的系统设计，从而将记忆构建的选择与检索质量混为一谈。 因此，我们遵循 LoCoMo 和 LifeBench 所确立的惯例，使用相同的下游任务性能指标来评估所有系统：问答准确率和 F1 值。

paragraphs.en: The comparability limitation above concerns systems with heterogeneous memory representations. For a controlled retrieval-side comparison, we additionally evaluate TsContriever, the semantic retriever used as NeSTR input, and TIDER on the same LifeBench memory pool ℳ \mathcal{M} . Because memory entries undergo extraction and rewriting, exact string matching cannot reliably align them with raw gold evidence. We therefore use an LLM coverage judge to assign binary relevance labels. Recall@ k k is the fraction of gold evidence covered by the top- k k results, averaged over queries; nDCG@20 measures ranking quality using the binary relevance labels; and MRR@20 is the mean reciprocal rank of the first relevant memory within the top-20 results. These judge-based diagnostics supplement, rather than replace, the end-to-end QA metrics.
paragraphs.zh: 上述可比性限制涉及具有异构记忆表示的系统。 为了进行受控的检索端比较，我们还对 TsContriever（作为 NeSTR 输入的语义检索器）和 TIDER 在相同的 LifeBench 记忆池 ℳ \mathcal{M} 上进行了评估。 由于记忆条目经过提取和重写，精确的字符串匹配无法可靠地将它们与原始黄金证据对齐。 因此，我们使用 LLM 覆盖度判断器来分配二值相关性标签。 Recall@ k k 是指前 k k 个结果所覆盖的黄金证据的比例，并在所有查询上取平均；nDCG@20 使用二值相关性标签衡量排序质量；而 MRR@20 则是前 20 个结果中首个相关记忆的平均倒数排名。 这些基于判断器的诊断指标是对端到端 QA 指标的补充，而非替代。

paragraphs.en: Table 4 shows that TIDER improves Recall@20 and nDCG@20 over the shared semantic retriever by 9.01 9.01 and 11.46 11.46 percentage points, respectively. Recall@10 is similar, while the larger Recall@20 and MRR@20 support improved evidence coverage and earlier ranking of relevant memories within the same representation. These results are conditional on the LLM coverage labels and should not be interpreted as representation-independent retrieval scores across native agentic-memory systems.

paragraphs.en: This appendix details the date extraction, clustering, and summarization steps that turn the raw dialogue 𝒞 \mathcal{C} into the temporally anchored event memory pool ℳ \mathcal{M} used by both retrieval channels; the full prompts driving these steps are listed in Appendix J.1 .
paragraphs.zh: 本附录详细说明了日期提取、聚类和摘要步骤，这些步骤将原始对话 𝒞 \mathcal{C} 转换为两个检索通道均使用的、带有时间锚定的事件记忆池 ℳ \mathcal{M}；驱动这些步骤的完整提示列于附录 J.1。

paragraphs.en: Each dialogue turn is processed by an LLM that extracts atomic memory items together with their associated dates. Items are then aggregated into clusters by a temporally-bounded greedy merge: an item joins an existing cluster only when its timestamp falls within Δ date = 7 \Delta_{\text{date}}=7 days of the cluster span and its semantic similarity (under the same dense retriever as the semantic channel) to the cluster centroid satisfies θ sem ≥ 0.85 \theta_{\text{sem}}\geq 0.85 ; clusters are capped at 40 40 items each—once a cluster reaches the cap, subsequent items spawn a new cluster even if both temporal and semantic conditions hold. Each surviving cluster i i records its date span d i = [ d i start , d i end ] d_{i}=[d_{i}^{\text{start}},d_{i}^{\text{end}}] , an LLM-generated event summary s i s_{i} , and the raw items ℐ i \mathcal{I}_{i} .
paragraphs.zh: 每个对话回合都由一个大型语言模型（LLM）处理，该模型会提取原子记忆项及其相关的日期。 随后，这些记忆项通过一种时间受限的贪心合并策略被聚合成簇：只有当某个记忆项的时间戳落在簇的时间跨度前后 Δ date = 7 \Delta_{\text{date}}=7 天范围内，且其语义相似度（使用与语义通道相同的全局检索器计算）满足 θ sem ≥ 0.85 \theta_{\text{sem}}\geq 0.85 时，该记忆项才会加入现有簇；每个簇最多容纳 40 个记忆项——一旦某个簇达到上限，后续的记忆项即使同时满足时间和语义条件，也会生成一个新的簇。 每个保留下来的簇 i 都会记录其日期跨度 d i = [ d i start , d i end ] d_{i}=[d_{i}^{\text{start}},d_{i}^{\text{end}}]、由 LLM 生成的事件摘要 s i s_{i}，以及原始记忆项 ℐ i \mathcal{I}_{i}。

paragraphs.en: Gold windows W gold W_{\text{gold}} . Derived deterministically from the dates in ℰ ∗ \mathcal{E}^{\ast} . Each evidence date is first cast as a degenerate single-day interval [ d , d ] [d,d] ; intervals are then sorted by start date and merged whenever the gap to the previous interval is fewer than three calendar days, otherwise emitted as a new window. Evidence with missing or unparseable dates is skipped. The resulting W gold W_{\text{gold}} collapses dense evidence clusters into a single tight window and exposes sparse clusters as multi-window targets, providing the natural difficulty stratification used in Appendix C .
paragraphs.zh: 黄金窗口 W gold W_{\text{gold}}。 由 ℰ ∗ \mathcal{E}^{\ast} 中的日期确定性地推导得出。 每个证据日期首先被转换为一个退化的单日区间 [ d , d ] [d,d]；随后，这些区间按起始日期排序，并且当与前一区间之间的间隔少于三天时进行合并，否则作为新的窗口发出。 日期缺失或无法解析的证据将被跳过。 最终得到的 W gold W_{\text{gold}} 将密集的证据簇坍缩为单个紧凑窗口，并将稀疏的簇暴露为多窗口目标，从而提供了附录 C 中使用的自然难度分层。

paragraphs.en: Temporal flag gold_temporal . A binary indicator of whether q q is time-sensitive. We obtain an initial label by prompting GPT-5.2 to classify each query in isolation, and a human annotator subsequently verifies every label and overrides the model decision when warranted. This two-stage pipeline reduces both false positives (queries whose evidence happens to carry incidental dates) and false negatives (implicitly temporal queries whose surface form omits explicit time markers).
paragraphs.zh: 时间标志 gold_temporal。 一个二元指示器，用于判断 q q 是否对时间敏感。 我们通过提示 GPT-5.2 单独分类每个查询来获得初始标签，随后由人工标注员验证每个标签，并在必要时覆盖模型的决定。 这种两阶段流程减少了误报（证据中恰好包含附带日期的查询）和漏报（表面形式未包含明确时间标记的隐含时间相关查询）。

paragraphs.en: Locator capacity is not the source of TIDER’s gains. We re-ran the full TIDER pipeline with a 4B locator under an identical training recipe; only the SFT cold-start and GRPO traces are model-specific, while the dual-channel retriever, prompts, and downstream LLM are unchanged. Figure 7 overlays the smoothed reward of the 4B run on the 1.7B run from Figure 6 : the two trajectories rise on a similar shape and converge to plateaus differing by less than 0.02 0.02 in reward, with the 4B run ascending marginally faster in the early phase. On the evaluation side, Table 10 reports end-to-end accuracy on LifeBench. Halving the locator from 4 4 B to 1.7 1.7 B parameters leaves Overall accuracy and average F1 effectively unchanged ( 61.52 61.52 vs 61.03 61.03 ; 0.6923 0.6923 vs 0.6957 0.6957 ), with per-category swings within ± 2.2 \pm 2.2 pp. We therefore adopt the 1.7 1.7 B locator as the default, attributing TIDER’s headroom to the dual-channel temporal anchor rather than to locator scale. TIDER thus inherits a lightweight characteristic, achieving competitive end-to-end accuracy under a substantially smaller locator parameter budget.
paragraphs.zh: Locator 的容量并非 TIDER 性能提升的来源。 我们在完全相同的训练方案下，使用一个 4B 的 locator 重新运行了完整的 TIDER 流程；只有 SFT 冷启动和 GRPO 轨迹是模型特定的，而双通道检索器、提示词以及下游 LLM 均未改变。 图 7 将 4B 运行的平滑奖励叠加在图 6 中的 1.7B 运行之上：两条轨迹呈现出相似的上升形态，并最终收敛到奖励值差异小于 0.02 的平台期，其中 4B 运行在早期阶段的上升速度略快。 在评估方面，表 10 报告了 LifeBench 上的端到端准确率。 将 locator 的参数规模从 4B 减半至 1.7B，实际上并未改变整体准确率和平均 F1 值（61.52 vs 61.03；0.6923 vs 0.6957），各分类的波动也控制在 ±2.2 pp 以内。 因此，我们采用 1.7B 的 locator 作为默认配置，并将 TIDER 的性能提升归因于双通道时间锚点，而非 locator 的规模。 因此，TIDER 继承了轻量级的特性，在 locator 参数规模大幅缩减的情况下，仍能实现具有竞争力的端到端准确率。

paragraphs.en: To separate the effects of memory construction and retrieval, we cross two memory representations with two retrieval methods on LifeBench. The fixed-chunk representation uses 512-token chunks with timestamps inherited from their source sessions, without LLM-based extraction, clustering, rewriting, or summarization; the locator directly consumes the timestamped chunks. The full representation uses the temporally anchored memory pool ℳ \mathcal{M} . Within each representation, we compare semantic-only retrieval with TIDER retrieval while holding the downstream answer model and retrieval budget fixed.
paragraphs.zh: 为了区分记忆构建和检索的影响，我们在 LifeBench 上将两种记忆表示与两种检索方法进行了交叉组合。 固定分块表示使用包含 512 个标记的分块，其时间戳继承自源会话，且未经基于大语言模型的提取、聚类、改写或摘要处理；定位器直接消耗这些带有时间戳的分块。 完整表示使用具有时间锚点的记忆池 ℳ \mathcal{M}。 在每种表示中，我们在保持下游答案模型和检索预算不变的情况下，比较了仅基于语义的检索与 TIDER 检索。

sents.zh: 为了区分记忆构建和检索的影响，我们在 LifeBench 上将两种记忆表示与两种检索方法进行了交叉组合。

sents.en: The full representation uses the temporally anchored memory pool ℳ \mathcal{M} .
sents.zh: 完整表示使用具有时间锚点的记忆池 ℳ \mathcal{M}。

sents.en: Within each representation, we compare semantic-only retrieval with TIDER retrieval while holding the downstream answer model and retrieval budget fixed.
sents.zh: 在每种表示中，我们在保持下游答案模型和检索预算不变的情况下，比较了仅基于语义的检索与 TIDER 检索。

paragraphs.en: TIDER improves accuracy by 8.09 8.09 percentage points on fixed chunks and 9.31 9.31 points on the full memory pool. Memory construction adds 1.72 1.72 points under semantic retrieval and 2.94 2.94 points under TIDER retrieval. The retrieval-time mechanism therefore remains effective without LLM-based memory construction, while the full memory pool provides an additional, retrieval-dependent benefit.
paragraphs.zh: TIDER 在固定分块上的准确率提升了 8.09 个百分点，在完整内存池上的准确率提升了 9.31 个百分点。 在语义检索中，内存构建带来了 1.72 个百分点的提升，在 TIDER 检索中则带来了 2.94 个百分点的提升。 因此，即使没有基于 LLM 的内存构建，检索时机制仍然有效，而完整内存池则提供了额外的、依赖于检索的收益。

paragraphs.en: Accuracy varies non-monotonically with k k . Increasing the semantic retrieval budget narrows the gap, but the best semantic-only result within the tested range is 57.73 % 57.73\% at k = 100 k=100 , still 3.79 3.79 percentage points below TIDER at k = 20 k=20 ( 61.52 % 61.52\% ). Increasing TIDER’s budget from 20 20 to 100 100 improves accuracy by only 0.49 0.49 points. These results support k = 20 k=20 as an effective operating point: TIDER achieves higher accuracy than the best tested semantic-only setting while retrieving one fifth as many memory units. This comparison concerns memory-unit counts, not measured token costs or end-to-end latency.
paragraphs.zh: 准确性随 k 的变化呈现非单调性。 增加语义检索预算可以缩小差距，但在测试范围内，仅使用语义方法的最佳结果在 k = 100 时达到 57.73%，仍比 k = 20 时的 TIDER（61.52%）低 3.79 个百分点。 将 TIDER 的预算从 20 增加到 100，准确性仅提升了 0.49 个百分点。 这些结果支持将 k = 20 作为有效的运行点：TIDER 在检索的内存单元数量仅为测试中最佳语义方法设置的五分之一的情况下，实现了更高的准确性。 此比较涉及的是内存单元的数量，而非实际测量的令牌成本或端到端延迟。

paragraphs.en: This appendix expands the one-line baseline descriptions in § 4.2 and details the implementation choices that ensure a fair comparison.
paragraphs.zh: 本附录对第 4.2 节中单行基线描述进行了扩展，并详细说明了确保公平比较的实现选择。

paragraphs.en: We group the six baselines into three families along their orthogonal design dimensions: agentic memory frameworks (MemOS, TiMem, Zep, Mem0) that target memory organization and lifecycle management, time-aware retrieval (TsContriever) that targets the retrieval encoder, and temporal reasoning (NeSTR) that targets answer-time inference over retrieved evidence. The summaries below paraphrase each paper’s stated contribution; the closing line marks what we preserve from the original method versus what we adapt to keep the comparison on equal footing with TIDER.
paragraphs.zh: 我们将这六个基线模型按照其正交的设计维度划分为三个类别：以记忆组织与生命周期管理为目标的智能体记忆框架（MemOS、TiMem、Zep、Mem0）；以检索编码器为目标的时敏检索（TsContriever）；以及针对检索证据进行答案时间推理的时序推理（NeSTR）。 以下摘要对每篇论文所声明的贡献进行了转述；最后一行标明了我们从原始方法中保留的部分，以及为了与 TIDER 保持公平比较而调整的内容。

sents.en: We group the six baselines into three families along their orthogonal design dimensions: agentic memory frameworks (MemOS, TiMem, Zep, Mem0) that target memory organization and lifecycle management, time-aware retrieval (TsContriever) that targets the retrieval encoder, and temporal reasoning (NeSTR) that targets answer-time inference over retrieved evidence.
sents.zh: 我们将这六个基线模型按照其正交的设计维度划分为三个类别：以记忆组织与生命周期管理为目标的智能体记忆框架（MemOS、TiMem、Zep、Mem0）；以检索编码器为目标的时敏检索（TsContriever）；以及针对检索证据进行答案时间推理的时序推理（NeSTR）。

paragraphs.en: MemOS [ 12 ] treats memory as a manageable system resource and proposes a memory operating system that unifies the representation, scheduling, and evolution of plaintext, activation-based, and parameter-level memories. Its basic unit, the MemCube, encapsulates memory content together with provenance and versioning metadata; MemCubes can be composed, migrated, and fused over time, bridging retrieval-style memory with parameter-based learning under explicit lifecycle control. Adapted: the downstream answer model is replaced by our shared LLM (GPT-5-mini on LifeBench, GPT-4o-mini on LoCoMo) so that gains attributable to memory organization are isolated from the choice of generator.
paragraphs.zh: MemOS [ 12 ] 将内存视为一种可管理的系统资源，并提出了一种内存操作系统，该系统集成地处理了明文记忆、激活基记忆和参数级记忆的表示、调度和演化。 其基本单元 MemCube 将内存内容与来源及版本元数据封装在一起；MemCubes 可以在时间推移中被组合、迁移和融合，从而在明确的生命周期控制下，连接检索式记忆与参数化学习。 调整说明：下游答案模型被替换为我们共享的 LLM（LifeBench 上的 GPT-5-mini，LoCoMo 上的 GPT-4o-mini），以便将源于内存组织结构的增益与生成模型的选择区分开来。

sents.en: MemOS [ 12 ] treats memory as a manageable system resource and proposes a memory operating system that unifies the representation, scheduling, and evolution of plaintext, activation-based, and parameter-level memories.

sents.en: Adapted: the downstream answer model is replaced by our shared LLM (GPT-5-mini on LifeBench, GPT-4o-mini on LoCoMo) so that gains attributable to memory organization are isolated from the choice of generator.
sents.zh: 调整说明：下游答案模型被替换为我们共享的 LLM（LifeBench 上的 GPT-5-mini，LoCoMo 上的 GPT-4o-mini），以便将源于内存组织结构的增益与生成模型的选择区分开来。

paragraphs.en: TiMem [ 11 ] is a temporal–hierarchical memory framework that organizes conversations through a Temporal Memory Tree (TMT), enabling systematic memory consolidation from raw observations to progressively abstracted persona representations. It is characterized by three properties: temporal–hierarchical organization through TMT, semantic-guided consolidation that integrates memory across hierarchical levels without fine-tuning, and complexity-aware memory recall that balances precision and efficiency across queries of varying complexity. Adapted: the downstream answer LLM is unified with the rest of the table, leaving TiMem’s memory tree as the only varying component.
paragraphs.zh: TiMem [ 11 ] 是一种时间–层次记忆框架，它通过时间记忆树（TMT）组织对话，从而实现从原始观察到逐步抽象的人物表征的系统性记忆巩固。 它具有三个特性：通过 TMT 实现的时间–层次组织、无需微调即可在多个层次间整合记忆的语义引导式巩固，以及能够平衡不同复杂度查询中精确性与效率的复杂度感知式记忆召回。 经过调整：下游的问答 LLM 已与其他表格内容统一，仅保留 TiMem 的记忆树作为唯一变化的组件。

sents.en: TiMem [ 11 ] is a temporal–hierarchical memory framework that organizes conversations through a Temporal Memory Tree (TMT), enabling systematic memory consolidation from raw observations to progressively abstracted persona representations.
sents.zh: TiMem [ 11 ] 是一种时间–层次记忆框架，它通过时间记忆树（TMT）组织对话，从而实现从原始观察到逐步抽象的人物表征的系统性记忆巩固。

paragraphs.en: Zep [ 21 ] is a memory-layer service for AI agents whose core component, Graphiti, dynamically synthesizes unstructured conversational data and structured business data into a temporally-aware knowledge graph that maintains historical relationships with explicit validity intervals. Zep was originally evaluated on Deep Memory Retrieval (DMR) and LongMemEval, where it improves over MemGPT and shows substantial gains on cross-session synthesis and long-term context maintenance with reduced response latency. Adapted: the answer model is unified across baselines.
paragraphs.zh: Zep [ 21 ] 是一项面向 AI 智能体的记忆层服务，其核心组件 Graphiti 能够将非结构化对话数据与结构化业务数据动态合成一个具备时间感知能力的知识图谱，该图谱会保留历史关系并附带明确的有效期区间。 Zep 最初在深度记忆检索（DMR）和 LongMemEval 测试中进行了评估，结果显示其性能优于 MemGPT，并在跨会话合成与长期上下文维护方面表现出显著提升，同时响应延迟也更低。 调整说明：各基准测试中的回答模型已统一。

sents.en: Zep [ 21 ] is a memory-layer service for AI agents whose core component, Graphiti, dynamically synthesizes unstructured conversational data and structured business data into a temporally-aware knowledge graph that maintains historical relationships with explicit validity intervals.
sents.zh: Zep [ 21 ] 是一项面向 AI 智能体的记忆层服务，其核心组件 Graphiti 能够将非结构化对话数据与结构化业务数据动态合成一个具备时间感知能力的知识图谱，该图谱会保留历史关系并附带明确的有效期区间。

sents.en: Adapted: the answer model is unified across baselines.
sents.zh: 调整说明：各基准测试中的回答模型已统一。

paragraphs.en: Mem0 [ 5 ] is a scalable memory-centric architecture that dynamically extracts, consolidates, and retrieves salient information from ongoing multi-session conversations, with an enhanced graph-based variant that captures relational structure among conversational elements. On the LOCOMO benchmark Mem0 reports a 26 % 26\% relative improvement over an OpenAI memory baseline under LLM-as-Judge while reducing p95 latency by 91 % 91\% and saving more than 90 % 90\% of token cost. Adapted: the downstream answer LLM and top- k k retrieval budget are unified.
paragraphs.zh: Mem0 [ 5 ] 是一种可扩展的以记忆为核心的架构，能够动态地从持续的多轮对话中提取、整合和检索关键信息；其增强版的图结构变体还能捕捉对话要素之间的关联结构。 在 LOCOMO 基准测试中，Mem0 在“大语言模型作为评判者”（LLM-as-Judge）模式下相比 OpenAI 的记忆基线模型实现了 26% 的相对性能提升，同时将 p95 延迟降低了 91%，并节省了超过 90% 的令牌成本。 改进之处：下游回答所用的大语言模型与 top-k 检索预算被统一整合。

sents.en: Mem0 [ 5 ] is a scalable memory-centric architecture that dynamically extracts, consolidates, and retrieves salient information from ongoing multi-session conversations, with an enhanced graph-based variant that captures relational structure among conversational elements.
sents.zh: Mem0 [ 5 ] 是一种可扩展的以记忆为核心的架构，能够动态地从持续的多轮对话中提取、整合和检索关键信息；其增强版的图结构变体还能捕捉对话要素之间的关联结构。

sents.en: On the LOCOMO benchmark Mem0 reports a 26 % 26\% relative improvement over an OpenAI memory baseline under LLM-as-Judge while reducing p95 latency by 91 % 91\% and saving more than 90 % 90\% of token cost.
sents.zh: 在 LOCOMO 基准测试中，Mem0 在“大语言模型作为评判者”（LLM-as-Judge）模式下相比 OpenAI 的记忆基线模型实现了 26% 的相对性能提升，同时将 p95 延迟降低了 91%，并节省了超过 90% 的令牌成本。

sents.en: Adapted: the downstream answer LLM and top- k k retrieval budget are unified.
sents.zh: 改进之处：下游回答所用的大语言模型与 top-k 检索预算被统一整合。

paragraphs.en: TsContriever [ 28 ] (a.k.a. TS-Retriever) is a time-sensitive retrieval-augmented generation method built on top of Contriever. It augments dense retrieval with supervised contrastive learning using temporally-constrained negatives, performs query-side fine-tuning to make the encoder sensitive to explicit temporal expressions, and routes queries through a temporal-need classifier so that general queries fall back to standard semantic retrieval. The original paper reports clear gains on a custom time-sensitive QA benchmark while preserving general-query effectiveness. Adapted: We preserve the four official checkpoints (plain, document, query, router) and the routing classifier. We disable the TIDER locator and plug TsContriever into our shared memory pool, retrieval pipeline, top- k k , and answer LLM, so the difference reflects the encoder change alone.
paragraphs.zh: TsContriever [28]（又称 TS-Retriever）是一种基于 Contriever 构建的时敏检索增强生成方法。它利用时间约束的负样本，通过监督对比学习来增强密集检索；对查询端进行微调，使编码器对明确的时间表达更加敏感；并通过一个时间需求分类器对查询进行路由，使得普通查询能够回退到标准的语义检索模式。原始论文在自定义的时敏问答基准测试中报告了明显的性能提升，同时保持了普通查询的有效性。改编说明：我们保留了四个官方检查点（plain、document、query、router）以及路由分类器。我们禁用了 TIDER 定位器，并将 TsContriever 集成到我们的共享内存池、检索流程、top-k k 和答案生成 LLM 中，因此差异仅反映编码器的变化。

paragraphs.en: NeSTR [ 13 ] is a Neuro-Symbolic Temporal Reasoning framework that integrates structured symbolic representations of temporal relations with hybrid reflective reasoning to enhance LLMs’ temporal sensitivity. It explicitly preserves temporal relations through symbolic encoding, enforces logical consistency through verification, and corrects flawed inferences via abductive reflection, achieving zero-shot gains on temporal QA benchmarks without any fine-tuning. Adapted: We preserve the NeSTR for response generation, including symbolic temporal encoding, consistency verification, and abductive reflection. We disable TIDER’s locator, temporal grounding and temporal reranker at the search stage, share the memory pool and dense retriever.
paragraphs.zh: NeSTR [ 13 ] 是一种神经符号时间推理框架，它将时间关系的结构化符号表示与混合反思性推理相结合，以增强大型语言模型的时间敏感性。 它通过符号编码明确保留时间关系，通过验证确保逻辑一致性，并通过溯因反思纠正错误推理，从而在时间问答基准测试中无需任何微调即可实现零样本性能提升。 改编：我们保留了 NeSTR 用于响应生成，包括符号时间编码、一致性验证和溯因反思。 我们在搜索阶段禁用了 TIDER 的定位器、时间接地和时间重排序器，并共享了内存池和密集检索器。

sents.en: NeSTR [ 13 ] is a Neuro-Symbolic Temporal Reasoning framework that integrates structured symbolic representations of temporal relations with hybrid reflective reasoning to enhance LLMs’ temporal sensitivity.
sents.zh: NeSTR [ 13 ] 是一种神经符号时间推理框架，它将时间关系的结构化符号表示与混合反思性推理相结合，以增强大型语言模型的时间敏感性。

sents.en: It explicitly preserves temporal relations through symbolic encoding, enforces logical consistency through verification, and corrects flawed inferences via abductive reflection, achieving zero-shot gains on temporal QA benchmarks without any fine-tuning.
sents.zh: 它通过符号编码明确保留时间关系，通过验证确保逻辑一致性，并通过溯因反思纠正错误推理，从而在时间问答基准测试中无需任何微调即可实现零样本性能提升。

sents.en: Adapted: We preserve the NeSTR for response generation, including symbolic temporal encoding, consistency verification, and abductive reflection.
sents.zh: 改编：我们保留了 NeSTR 用于响应生成，包括符号时间编码、一致性验证和溯因反思。

sents.en: We disable TIDER’s locator, temporal grounding and temporal reranker at the search stage, share the memory pool and dense retriever.
sents.zh: 我们在搜索阶段禁用了 TIDER 的定位器、时间接地和时间重排序器，并共享了内存池和密集检索器。

paragraphs.en: We do not include training-based temporal-reasoning methods such as Memory-T1 [ 6 ] as direct baselines, since they fine-tune the response model whereas our evaluation keeps the downstream LLM fixed across methods.
paragraphs.zh: 我们没有将基于训练的时间推理方法（如 Memory-T1 [6]）作为直接基线纳入比较，因为这些方法会对响应模型进行微调，而我们的评估在所有方法中均保持下游大型语言模型（LLM）不变。

paragraphs.en: This appendix reports the detailed quantitative evidence behind the LifeBench comparisons: accuracy stratified by gold-window-count category (§ F.1 ) and paired significance tests on per-question correctness (§ F.2 ).
paragraphs.zh: 本附录报告了 LifeBench 比较背后的详细定量证据：按黄金窗口计数类别分层计算的准确率（§ F.1），以及对每个问题正确性的配对显著性检验（§ F.2）。

paragraphs.en: Table 14 reports per-category accuracy of all seven baselines on the official LifeBench user-0 / user-1 slice ( n = 408 n{=}408 ), using the same four categories visualized in Fig. 3 : non-temporal ( n = 50 n{=}50 ), single-window ( n = 228 n{=}228 ), dual-window ( n = 103 n{=}103 ), and multi-window ( n = 27 n{=}27 ). Means and standard deviations are reported over three independent evaluation runs.
paragraphs.zh: 表 14 报告了所有七种基线模型在官方 LifeBench user-0 / user-1 切片（n = 408 n{=}408）上的各类别准确率，其中使用了图 3 中可视化的相同四个类别：非时间类（n = 50 n{=}50）、单窗口类（n = 228 n{=}228）、双窗口类（n = 103 n{=}103）和多窗口类（n = 27 n{=}27）。 均值和标准差基于三次独立的评估运行报告得出。

sents.en: Table 14 reports per-category accuracy of all seven baselines on the official LifeBench user-0 / user-1 slice ( n = 408 n{=}408 ), using the same four categories visualized in Fig. 3 : non-temporal ( n = 50 n{=}50 ), single-window ( n = 228 n{=}228 ), dual-window ( n = 103 n{=}103 ), and multi-window ( n = 27 n{=}27 ).

paragraphs.en: Table 15 reports paired significance tests comparing TIDER against each baseline on the same 408 answerable LifeBench questions. We use the two-sided exact McNemar test on paired binary correctness outcomes and apply Holm correction across the six TIDER-versus-baseline comparisons. In the table, b b counts questions answered correctly by TIDER but incorrectly by the baseline, while c c counts the reverse direction.

paragraphs.en: For each incorrect answer, we ask an LLM reviewer to assign exactly one primary error cause by comparing the question, gold answer, model answer, gold evidence, and retrieved context (Appendix J.5 ). The labels are: retrieval miss , where the answer-bearing evidence is absent; temporal mismatch , where related evidence is retrieved from the wrong time; partial evidence , where only part of the required evidence is retrieved; and reason failure , where sufficient evidence is present but the answer model reasons or selects incorrectly. We define retrieval-side failure as the union of retrieval miss, temporal mismatch, and partial evidence.
paragraphs.zh: 对于每个错误答案，我们要求一个 LLM 评审员通过比较问题、标准答案、模型答案、标准证据和检索到的上下文（附录 J.5），指定且仅指定一个主要错误原因。 标签包括：检索缺失（即包含答案的证据未出现）；时间不匹配（即相关证据从错误的时间点被检索到）；部分证据（即仅检索到所需证据的一部分）；以及推理失败（即存在足够证据，但答案模型在推理或选择时出错）。 我们将检索侧的失败定义为检索缺失、时间不匹配和部分证据的并集。

paragraphs.en: Table 16 shows that most failures are retrieval-side rather than pure answer-generation failures. Temporal mismatch is the dominant failure type for MemOS, Mem0, NeSTR, and TIDER, while TiMem and TsContriever still exhibit many retrieval misses, indicating that their retrievers often fail before temporal disambiguation can help. Overall, the diagnosis supports the paper’s central claim: long-horizon memory QA is bottlenecked by retrieving the right evidence from the right time, not merely by answer-time reasoning.
paragraphs.zh: 表 16 显示，大多数故障属于检索环节的问题，而非纯粹的答案生成问题。 对于 MemOS、Mem0、NeSTR 和 TIDER 而言，时间不匹配是主要的故障类型；而 TiMem 和 TsContriever 仍存在大量检索遗漏，这表明它们的检索模块往往在时间消歧发挥作用之前就已失败。 总体而言，这一诊断结果支持了本文的核心论点：长期记忆问答的瓶颈在于从正确的时间点检索到正确的证据，而不仅仅是答案生成阶段的推理能力。

paragraphs.en: We summarize the recurring baseline failure modes observed across cases and then walk through three representative cases covering single-, dual-, and multi-window queries.
paragraphs.zh: 我们总结了在各个案例中反复出现的基准失败模式，然后逐一分析三个具有代表性的案例，涵盖单窗口、双窗口和多窗口查询。

paragraphs.en: Baseline mistakes fall into five recurring patterns: (i) topic shell only —retrieved context preserves the right person and broad theme but loses the specific event core (e.g., MemOS, Zep on q100 , q181 ); (ii) event substitution with temporal drift —a same-person event from a nearby month replaces the queried one (e.g., TiMem and Mem0 on q100 , q181 ); (iii) long-term persona suppression —high-frequency identity facts override the question’s specific temporal window (e.g., MemOS and TsContriever on q143 ); (iv) single-endpoint capture —one of two required temporal anchors is retrieved while the other is dropped (e.g., MemOS, NeSTR on q120 , q193 ); and (v) near-total miss —retrieval finds little relevant content (e.g., TsContriever on q100 , q164 ). The three walk-throughs below illustrate (i)–(iv); failure mode (v) is largely confined to TsContriever and is consistent with its low overall accuracy in Table 14 .
paragraphs.zh: 基线模型出现的错误可分为五种重复模式：（i）仅保留主题外壳——检索到的上下文保留了正确的人物和大致主题，但丢失了具体事件的核心内容（例如，MemOS、Zep 在 q100、q181 上的表现）；（ii）事件替换并伴随时间偏移——同一人物在近一个月发生的事件取代了被查询的事件（例如，TiMem 和 Mem0 在 q100、q181 上的表现）；（iii）长期人格特征压制——高频的身份信息覆盖了问题中指定的特定时间窗口（例如，MemOS 和 TsContriever 在 q143 上的表现）；（iv）仅捕捉单一时间锚点——两个必要的时间锚点中只有一个被检索到，而另一个则被忽略（例如，MemOS、NeSTR 在 q120、q193 上的表现）；以及（v）近乎完全遗漏——检索几乎找不到任何相关内容（例如，TsContriever 在 q100、q164 上的表现）。 以下三种演示说明了模式（i）至（iv）；失败模式（v）主要局限于 TsContriever，这与表 14 中其整体准确率较低的情况一致。

paragraphs.en: The question asks what trouble Huang Wenhui ran into in March 2025; the gold answer is that her pre-sold apartment project halted construction amid rumors that the developer’s cash flow had broken down. Within the same conversational thread, Huang Wenhui appears in at least five negatively-toned events spread across the year—a January cafe scam ( q181 ), the March apartment halt, an April game-project conflict ( q28 ), April/July neighbor-dog disturbances ( q98 , q37 ), and a September app-launch slump ( q49 )—so the challenge is isolating the March incident from this same-entity cluster. TIDER retrieves the March 12 messages that explicitly mention the halted construction site, the broken developer cash flow, and the continuing mortgage pressure. MemOS and Zep keep only the topic shell (“A-Hui has a housing problem”); TiMem replaces the event with a later apartment-water-leak story; Mem0 drifts to the July neighbor-dog incident; NeSTR preserves the negative-affect shell but slides to the January cafe scam. All baselines identify the correct entity, but only TIDER recovers the correct month-event pair.
paragraphs.zh: 问题询问黄文慧在2025年3月遇到了什么麻烦；标准答案是，由于开发商现金流断裂的传闻，她已预售的公寓项目停工了。 在同一对话线程中，黄文慧全年至少出现在五个负面事件里——1月的咖啡馆骗局（q181）、3月的公寓项目停工、4月的游戏项目冲突（q28）、4月/7月的邻居养狗扰民事件（q98、q37），以及9月的一款应用发布失利（q49）——因此挑战在于如何将该年3月的事件从这一同一实体的事件群中区分出来。 TIDER检索到了3月12日的消息，其中明确提到了停工的施工现场、开发商现金流断裂以及持续存在的房贷压力。 MemOS和Zep仅保留了话题外壳（“阿慧有住房问题”）；TiMem用后来发生的公寓漏水事件替换了原事件；Mem0则偏离到了7月的邻居养狗事件；NeSTR虽然保留了负面情感的外壳，却转向了1月的咖啡馆骗局。 所有基线模型都识别出了正确的实体，但只有TIDER恢复了正确的月份与事件的对应关系。

paragraphs.en: The question asks for the user’s core activities on the first weekend after moving (June 14–15). The gold answer requires a complete two-day chain: a park walk and a housewarming dinner on day one, then a Pilates session and a pottery-class breakthrough on day two. TIDER retrieves evidence for all four components, with both days’ messages co-occurring in its retrieved context, and answers the chain completely. MemOS retains the park-walk fragment but drops the second-day activities; TiMem and Zep pull in broadly related “new-home” or “weekend” memories without preserving the precise two-day structure; NeSTR captures the park and pottery pieces but misses Pilates. The challenge here is not topical relevance but preserving every answer-bearing endpoint required by a temporally compositional question.
paragraphs.zh: 该问题询问用户在搬家后的第一个周末（6月14日至15日）的主要活动。 标准答案需要完整呈现两天的活动链：第一天包括公园散步和乔迁晚宴，第二天则包括普拉提课程和陶艺课上的突破。 TIDER检索到了全部四个组成部分的证据，两天内的消息均同时出现在其检索到的上下文中，并完整回答了整个活动链。 MemOS保留了公园散步的片段，但遗漏了第二天的活动；TiMem和Zep则调用了广泛相关的“新家”或“周末”记忆，却未能保留精确的两天结构；NeSTR捕捉到了公园和陶艺的部分信息，但漏掉了普拉提课程。 此处的挑战并非主题相关性，而是如何保留一个具有时间组合特征的问题所要求的所有承载答案的关键节点。

paragraphs.en: The question asks what the user’s main work content was at Zhengzhou Central Hospital between August 11 and August 27; the gold answer is a respiratory-medicine rotation, including community-acquired pneumonia admissions, a COPD exacerbation case, a difficult-case discussion meeting, and the associated discharge documentation. TIDER’s retrieved context anchors the August 11 admission and initial-course record, the August 21 case-discussion presentation, and the August 27 differential-diagnosis preparation, and additionally surfaces a “reviewing the respiratory medicine section” note. MemOS, Zep, and TsContriever all collapse back to the user’s long-running cardiology persona (resident physician, cardiology rounds, cardiology case work), missing the temporary respiratory rotation entirely; TiMem fails to retrieve a coherent August 11–27 chain; Mem0 surfaces individual clinical actions but drops the rotation-stage label. This case illustrates how high-frequency persona evidence can override a specific time-bounded stage, and how TIDER’s window-anchored retrieval resists this drift.
paragraphs.zh: 该问题询问用户在 8 月 11 日至 8 月 27 日期间在郑州中心医院的主要工作内容；标准答案应为呼吸科轮转，包括社区获得性肺炎的入院病例、一例 COPD 急性加重病例、一次疑难病例讨论会以及相关的出院记录。 TIDER 检索到的上下文信息锚定了 8 月 11 日的入院及初始病程记录、8 月 21 日的病例讨论演示，以及 8 月 27 日的鉴别诊断准备材料，并额外呈现了“回顾呼吸科部分”的笔记。 MemOS、Zep 和 TsContriever 均回归到用户长期存在的内科（心脏方向）角色设定（住院医师、心脏科查房、心脏科病例工作），完全忽略了临时的呼吸科轮转；TiMem 未能检索出贯穿 8 月 11 日至 27 日的连贯信息链；Mem0 虽然呈现了个别临床操作，但遗漏了轮转阶段的标识。 该案例说明，高频出现的角色设定证据如何可能覆盖某个特定时间阶段，以及 TIDER 基于时间窗口的检索机制如何抵抗这种偏离。

sents.zh: MemOS、Zep 和 TsContriever 均回归到用户长期存在的内科（心脏方向）角色设定（住院医师、心脏科查房、心脏科病例工作），完全忽略了临时的呼吸科轮转；TiMem 未能检索出贯穿 8 月 11 日至 27 日的连贯信息链；Mem0 虽然呈现了个别临床操作，但遗漏了轮转阶段的标识。

sents.en: This case illustrates how high-frequency persona evidence can override a specific time-bounded stage, and how TIDER’s window-anchored retrieval resists this drift.
sents.zh: 该案例说明，高频出现的角色设定证据如何可能覆盖某个特定时间阶段，以及 TIDER 基于时间窗口的检索机制如何抵抗这种偏离。

paragraphs.en: We measure the marginal latency introduced by TIDER’s temporal channel on the LifeBench-EN test split, holding the GPT-5-mini answer step fixed and toggling only the temporal pathway. The 1.7B locator is served on a single A100 80GB via vLLM. Averaged across 408 408 questions, enabling the temporal channel adds 0.41 0.41 s of wall-clock latency per query relative to the no-temporal baseline; this overhead aggregates the locator forward pass, the timeline-summary retrieval branch, and the distance-decay rerank that fuses the two channels. The figure is well below the cost of the downstream answer call, which dominates end-to-end response time at the several-second scale, so the dual-channel design recovers the accuracy gap reported in Section 4 without bottlenecking the GPT-5-mini / GPT-4o-mini answer step.
paragraphs.zh: 我们在 LifeBench-EN 测试集上测量了 TIDER 的时间通道所引入的边缘延迟，其中保持 GPT-5-mini 的答案步骤固定不变，仅切换时间通路。 该 1.7B 定位器通过 vLLM 在单个 A100 80GB 显卡上运行。 在 408 个问题上进行平均后，启用时间通道会使每次查询的实墙延迟相比无时间通道的基线增加 0.41 秒；这一额外开销包含了定位器的前向传播、时间线摘要检索分支，以及融合两个通道的距离衰减重排序步骤。 该数值远低于下游答案调用的成本——后者以数秒级的时长主导了端到端的响应时间，因此双通道设计在填补第 4 节中报告的准确率差距时，并未造成 GPT-5-mini / GPT-4o-mini 答案步骤的瓶颈。

paragraphs.en: We discuss three limitations of TIDER that are visible from the current setup and shape the most natural next steps; each isolates a distinct failure axis (data realism, upstream memory dependency, language coverage) so that the relative weight of remediation effort is clear to the reader.
paragraphs.zh: 我们讨论了 TIDER 在现有设置中显现出的三个局限性，这些局限性也决定了最自然的后续步骤；每个局限性都分别对应一个独特的失效维度（数据真实性、上游记忆依赖性和语言覆盖范围），从而使读者能够清楚地了解各项改进工作的相对重要性。

paragraphs.en: LifeBench is generated by an anonymized-persona-driven simulator with explicit temporal anchoring and cross-source consistency checks, and LoCoMo is multi-session synthetic dialogue rather than real long-term user data. Real personal traces likely contain heavier noise, more frequent timestamp gaps, and stronger cross-source contradictions than either benchmark exposes. Validating TIDER on a real, consented personal-memory corpus—under the privacy and retention safeguards discussed in Appendix I.2 —therefore remains an open direction, and the gains we report should be read as upper bounds achievable when the temporal signal is well-formed.
paragraphs.zh: LifeBench 由一个以匿名化人格为驱动、具有明确时间锚定和跨源一致性检查的模拟器生成，而 LoCoMo 是多会话的合成对话，而非真实的长期用户数据。 真实个人轨迹可能包含比这两个基准数据集所揭示的更多噪声、更频繁的时间戳缺失以及更强的跨源矛盾。 因此，在附录 I.2 中讨论的隐私与数据保留保障下，于一个经过同意的真实个人记忆语料库上验证 TIDER 仍然是一个开放的研究方向；我们报告的性能提升应被理解为在时间信号结构良好时可达到的上限。

paragraphs.en: TIDER’s temporal channel operates on a query-adaptive timeline summary 𝒮 q \mathcal{S}_{q} drawn from clustered memory items in the memory pool ℳ \mathcal{M} (Appendix B ). We deliberately keep this construction as simple as possible—temporally bounded clustering followed by a single-pass summarization prompt—so that the locator does not couple to a bespoke memory representation; even so, 𝒮 q \mathcal{S}_{q} still inherits the quality of upstream item extraction, since mis-dated, mis-attributed, or fragmented items propagate into the cluster boundaries and into the resulting summary. The locator can only filter on this view, so its window predictions degrade whenever the upstream memory pool is noisy.
paragraphs.zh: TIDER 的时间通道基于一个查询自适应的时间线摘要 𝒮 q \mathcal{S}_{q} 运行，该摘要从记忆池 ℳ \mathcal{M} 中的聚类记忆项中提取（附录 B）。 我们刻意将这一构造设计得尽可能简单——即先进行时间范围有限的聚类，再使用单遍摘要提示——以确保定位器不会与特定的记忆表示耦合；即便如此，𝒮 q \mathcal{S}_{q} 仍然继承了上游项提取的质量，因为日期错误、归属错误或片段化的项会传播到聚类边界以及最终的摘要中。 定位器只能基于这一视图进行过滤，因此一旦上游记忆池存在噪声，其窗口预测就会下降。

paragraphs.en: LifeBench and LoCoMo are both English-only, so TIDER’s evaluation does not cover languages whose date conventions diverge from the Gregorian numerical form (e.g., Chinese lunar dates, Japanese era names) or whose temporal expressions carry richer morphological cues. The locator prompt and the gold-window construction both rely on the parser shipped with our extractor, which is calibrated for English; cross-lingual deployment will likely require multilingual date normalization upstream of the temporal channel before the locator’s window predictions become meaningful.
paragraphs.zh: LifeBench 和 LoCoMo 都仅支持英语，因此 TIDER 的评估并未涵盖日期格式与公历数字形式不同的语言（例如中国农历日期、日本年号），或时间表达中包含更丰富形态学线索的语言。 定位提示词和金窗口构建均依赖于我们提取器附带的解析器，而该解析器是针对英语校准的；跨语言部署很可能需要在时间通道之前，于上游进行多语言日期标准化，才能使定位器的窗口预测具有实际意义。

paragraphs.en: TIDER targets long-term personalized assistants whose factual grounding rests on a temporally anchored memory pool; we discuss its societal impact along three positive axes and two risk axes, and note one experimental safeguard. On the positive side: (i) the dual-channel design strengthens the reliability of long-term personal-assistant deployments that must reason over months or years of dialogue history; (ii) by filtering candidates against query-relevant temporal windows rather than reweighting them after generation, the temporal channel directly reduces cross-time evidence hallucinations at the retrieval stage; and (iii) the locator’s window predictions W pred W_{\text{pred}} are user-inspectable, exposing which time region the system treated as relevant and giving end users an auditable handle on retrieval decisions. Two principal risks remain: (i) an adversary who can write into the dialogue stream may craft contradictory or fabricated dates that push the locator toward an incorrect window, thereby suppressing or surfacing specific memories at retrieval time; and (ii) any bias in the upstream LLM-based extractor—including event misattribution along demographic or linguistic lines—propagates directly into the temporally bounded clusters and the resulting timeline summary 𝒮 q \mathcal{S}_{q} , so locator decisions inherit those biases without an independent corrective step. As an experimental safeguard, all training and evaluation in this paper use synthetic benchmarks (LifeBench, LoCoMo); no real consented personal-memory corpus was used at any stage.
paragraphs.zh: TIDER 针对长期个性化智能体，其事实依据依赖于一个时间锚定的记忆池；我们从三个积极影响轴和两个风险轴探讨了其社会影响，并提及了一项实验性保障措施。 积极方面包括：(i) 双通道设计增强了长期个性化智能体部署的可靠性，这些部署需要基于数月甚至数年的对话历史进行推理；(ii) 通过在查询相关的时间窗口内筛选候选项，而非在生成后重新加权，时间通道直接在检索阶段减少了跨时间证据的幻觉；(iii) 定位器的窗口预测 W pred W_{\text{pred}} 可供用户查看，从而暴露系统认为相关的时间区域，并让用户能够审计检索决策。 仍存在两个主要风险：(i) 能够写入对话流的攻击者可能构造矛盾或伪造的日期，将定位器推向错误的窗口，从而在检索时抑制或凸显特定记忆；(ii) 上游基于 LLM 的提取器中的任何偏见——包括按人口统计或语言特征对事件进行错误归因——都会直接传播到时间受限的聚类以及最终的时序摘要 𝒮 q \mathcal{S}_{q}，因此定位器的决策会继承这些偏见，而缺乏独立的纠正步骤。 作为一项实验性保障措施，本文所有训练和评估均使用合成基准（LifeBench、LoCoMo）；在任何阶段均未使用任何经过真实用户同意的个人记忆语料库。

paragraphs.en: This appendix lists the prompts used by the memory pool builder, the locator, and the two LLM judges in the exact form fed to the underlying LLMs (§ J.1 –§ J.4 ), and reports a cross-judge consistency audit (§ J.6 ).

paragraphs.en: The two prompts that drive memory-pool construction are listed below.
paragraphs.zh: 驱动记忆池构建的两个提示词列于下方。

paragraphs.en: Used to merge the items in a temporally bounded cluster (or sub-cluster) into a single chronologically-ordered event summary, with date extraction and entity disambiguation handled inline.
paragraphs.zh: 用于将时间受限的簇（或子簇）中的项目合并为一个按时间顺序排列的事件摘要，其中日期提取和实体消歧会在线处理。

paragraphs.en: Used to subdivide an oversized cluster into 2–10-item sub-clusters before summarization.
paragraphs.zh: 用于在摘要生成前，将超大聚类细分为包含 2–10 个项目的子聚类。

paragraphs.en: The locator π θ \pi_{\theta} emits a single JSON object with two fields per query: a temporal-sensitivity flag and a list of temporal windows.
paragraphs.zh: 定位器 π θ \pi_{\theta} 每次查询都会输出一个包含两个字段的 JSON 对象：一个时间敏感性标志和一个时间窗口列表。

paragraphs.en: The detect field follows the temporal-sensitivity definition listed below, which is the prompt fed to GPT-5.2 to label gold_temporal during training-data construction (Appendix C ); π θ \pi_{\theta} is trained to imitate this judgment. The prompt text itself uses the detect key so that the annotation format matches the locator schema. Window prediction is supervised directly from ( q , W gold ) (q,W_{\text{gold}}) pairs and does not require a separate LLM prompt template at data-construction time.
