sents.zh: 窗口预测直接通过 ( q , W gold ) (q,W_{\text{gold}}) 对进行监督学习，在数据构建阶段无需额外的 LLM 提示模板。

paragraphs.en: Answer generation and answer judging are kept separate. The downstream answer is generated by a frozen LLM, but the answer-generation prompt is dataset-specific: following the LifeBench paper’s official evaluation requirement, LifeBench uses the official QA_PROMPT from the LoCoMo reference implementation, whereas LoCoMo uses the Mem0-style ANSWER_PROMPT_MEM0 . In both datasets, answer correctness is judged with the official LoCoMo prompt reproduced below; we invoke the same judge prompt independently three times and use majority vote (CORRECT in at least two of three calls) as the final label.
paragraphs.zh: 答案生成与答案判断保持分离。 下游答案由一个冻结的 LLM 生成，但答案生成提示词是数据集特定的：遵循 LifeBench 论文的官方评估要求，LifeBench 使用 LoCoMo 参考实现中的官方 QA_PROMPT，而 LoCoMo 则使用 Mem0 风格的 ANSWER_PROMPT_MEM0。 在这两个数据集中，答案的正确性均通过下方复现的官方 LoCoMo 提示词进行判断；我们独立调用相同的判断提示词三次，并以多数投票（三次调用中至少两次为 CORRECT）作为最终标签。

paragraphs.en: The evidence-coverage judge r evd r_{\text{evd}} is a reward that measures item-level evidence recall: for each question, the reviewer independently checks every gold evidence item and returns r evd = m / n r_{\text{evd}}=m/n , where n n is the number of gold evidence items and m m is the number of items explicitly covered by the retrieved memory set ℰ ^ \hat{\mathcal{E}} . The reward is therefore a floating-point value in [ 0 , 1 ] [0,1] .
paragraphs.zh: 证据覆盖度判分 r evd r_{\text{evd}} 是一种衡量项目级证据召回率的奖励：对于每个问题，评审员会独立检查每一条标准答案中的证据项，并返回 r evd = m / n r_{\text{evd}}=m/n，其中 n n 是标准答案中证据项的数量，而 m m 是被检索记忆集 ℰ ^ \hat{\mathcal{E}} 明确覆盖的证据项数量。 因此，该奖励是一个位于 [ 0 , 1 ] [0,1] 范围内的浮点数值。

paragraphs.en: The following prompt is used for the LLM reviewer in Appendix G.1 .
paragraphs.zh: 以下提示用于附录 G.1 中的 LLM 评审员。

paragraphs.en: This appendix audits the variance of the LLM judges used for GRPO.
paragraphs.zh: 本附录对用于 GRPO 的 LLM 评判者的方差进行了审计。

paragraphs.en: To audit cross-model agreement, we re-evaluate the same response set ( n = 408 n=408 from LifeBench user-0 and user-1) with two additional judges drawn from different model families— claude-sonnet-4-6 (Anthropic) and gemini-3.1-flash-lite-preview-nothink (Google)—using the exact same system and user prompts as the gpt-5-mini judge reported in the main paper.
paragraphs.zh: 为了审计跨模型一致性，我们使用与主论文中 gpt-5-mini 智能体报告完全相同的系统和用户提示，用另外两名来自不同模型家族的评判者——claude-sonnet-4-6（Anthropic）和 gemini-3.1-flash-lite-preview-nothink（Google）——重新评估了同一组响应（n = 408 n=408，来自 LifeBench 的 user-0 和 user-1）。

paragraphs.en: All three pairwise Cohen’s κ \kappa values lie in [ 0.836 , 0.894 ] [0.836,0.894] , well above the 0.81 0.81 threshold conventionally interpreted as “almost perfect” agreement. We therefore report a single judge ( gpt-5-mini ) throughout the main paper without loss of generality.
paragraphs.zh: 所有三个成对 Cohen’s κ \kappa 值都位于 [0.836, 0.894] 区间内，远高于通常被解释为“几乎完美”一致性的 0.81 阈值。 因此，我们在整篇主论文中报告了单一评判者（gpt-5-mini），而不会损失普遍性。

paragraphs.en: Question: Do the main claims made in the abstract and introduction accurately reflect the paper’s contributions and scope?
paragraphs.zh: 问题：摘要和引言中提出的主要论点是否准确反映了该论文的贡献和范围？

paragraphs.en: Justification: The abstract and introduction state the TIDER framework, the RL-trained temporal interval locator, the dual-channel retrieval mechanism, and the reported gains on LifeBench and LoCoMo. These claims are supported by the main results in Section 4.3 and ablations in Section 4.4 .
paragraphs.zh: 理由：摘要和引言部分介绍了 TIDER 框架、通过强化学习训练的时间间隔定位器、双通道检索机制，以及在 LifeBench 和 LoCoMo 上报告的性能提升。 这些主张得到了第 4.3 节中的主要结果以及第 4.4 节中消融实验的支持。

sents.en: Justification: The abstract and introduction state the TIDER framework, the RL-trained temporal interval locator, the dual-channel retrieval mechanism, and the reported gains on LifeBench and LoCoMo.
sents.zh: 理由：摘要和引言部分介绍了 TIDER 框架、通过强化学习训练的时间间隔定位器、双通道检索机制，以及在 LifeBench 和 LoCoMo 上报告的性能提升。

sents.en: These claims are supported by the main results in Section 4.3 and ablations in Section 4.4 .
sents.zh: 这些主张得到了第 4.3 节中的主要结果以及第 4.4 节中消融实验的支持。

paragraphs.en: The answer [N/A] means that the abstract and introduction do not include the claims made in the paper.
paragraphs.zh: 答案 [N/A] 表示摘要和引言中未包含论文中提出的主张。

paragraphs.en: The abstract and/or introduction should clearly state the claims made, including the contributions made in the paper and important assumptions and limitations. A [No] or [N/A] answer to this question will not be perceived well by the reviewers.
paragraphs.zh: 摘要和/或引言应明确陈述论文中提出的主张，包括论文的贡献以及重要的假设和局限性。 对这个问题回答 [否] 或 [不适用] 将不会被评审人看好。

sents.en: The abstract and/or introduction should clearly state the claims made, including the contributions made in the paper and important assumptions and limitations.
sents.zh: 摘要和/或引言应明确陈述论文中提出的主张，包括论文的贡献以及重要的假设和局限性。

sents.en: A [No] or [N/A] answer to this question will not be perceived well by the reviewers.
sents.zh: 对这个问题回答 [否] 或 [不适用] 将不会被评审人看好。

paragraphs.en: The claims made should match theoretical and experimental results, and reflect how much the results can be expected to generalize to other settings.
paragraphs.zh: 所提出的主张应与理论和实验结果相符，并反映这些结果在多大程度上可以推广到其他情境。

paragraphs.en: It is fine to include aspirational goals as motivation as long as it is clear that these goals are not attained by the paper.
paragraphs.zh: 只要明确说明本文并未实现这些目标，那么将理想化的目标作为动机是可以接受的。

paragraphs.en: Question: Does the paper discuss the limitations of the work performed by the authors?
paragraphs.zh: 问题：本文是否讨论了作者所完成工作的局限性？

paragraphs.en: Justification: Appendix I.1 discusses limitations from synthetic personal histories, dependence on upstream memory-item extraction, and English-only evaluation.
paragraphs.zh: 理由：附录 I.1 讨论了合成个人历史所带来的局限性、对上游记忆项提取的依赖，以及仅限英语的评估问题。

paragraphs.en: The answer [N/A] means that the paper has no limitation while the answer [No] means that the paper has limitations, but those are not discussed in the paper.
paragraphs.zh: 答案 [N/A] 表示该论文没有局限性，而答案 [No] 则表示该论文存在局限性，但这些局限性在论文中并未被讨论。

paragraphs.en: The authors are encouraged to create a separate “Limitations” section in their paper.
paragraphs.zh: 作者被鼓励在论文中创建一个独立的“局限性”部分。

paragraphs.en: The paper should point out any strong assumptions and how robust the results are to violations of these assumptions (e.g., independence assumptions, noiseless settings, model well-specification, asymptotic approximations only holding locally). The authors should reflect on how these assumptions might be violated in practice and what the implications would be.
paragraphs.zh: 论文应指出任何较强的假设，以及结果在违反这些假设时具有多强的稳健性（例如，独立性假设、无噪声设定、模型规格正确性，以及仅在局部成立的渐近近似）。 作者应反思这些假设在实践中可能如何被违反，以及由此带来的影响。

sents.en: The paper should point out any strong assumptions and how robust the results are to violations of these assumptions (e.g., independence assumptions, noiseless settings, model well-specification, asymptotic approximations only holding locally).
sents.zh: 论文应指出任何较强的假设，以及结果在违反这些假设时具有多强的稳健性（例如，独立性假设、无噪声设定、模型规格正确性，以及仅在局部成立的渐近近似）。

sents.en: The authors should reflect on how these assumptions might be violated in practice and what the implications would be.
sents.zh: 作者应反思这些假设在实践中可能如何被违反，以及由此带来的影响。

paragraphs.en: The authors should reflect on the scope of the claims made, e.g., if the approach was only tested on a few datasets or with a few runs. In general, empirical results often depend on implicit assumptions, which should be articulated.
paragraphs.zh: 作者应反思所提出主张的范围，例如，该方法是否仅在少数数据集上或仅通过少量运行进行了测试。 通常而言，经验性结果往往依赖于隐含的假设，这些假设应当被明确阐述。

sents.en: The authors should reflect on the scope of the claims made, e.g., if the approach was only tested on a few datasets or with a few runs.
sents.zh: 作者应反思所提出主张的范围，例如，该方法是否仅在少数数据集上或仅通过少量运行进行了测试。

sents.en: In general, empirical results often depend on implicit assumptions, which should be articulated.
sents.zh: 通常而言，经验性结果往往依赖于隐含的假设，这些假设应当被明确阐述。

paragraphs.en: The authors should reflect on the factors that influence the performance of the approach. For example, a facial recognition algorithm may perform poorly when image resolution is low or images are taken in low lighting. Or a speech-to-text system might not be used reliably to provide closed captions for online lectures because it fails to handle technical jargon.
paragraphs.zh: 作者应反思影响该方法性能的因素。 例如，当图像分辨率较低或图像在低光照条件下拍摄时，人脸识别算法的性能可能会很差。 或者，语音转文字系统可能无法可靠地用于为在线课程提供字幕，因为它无法处理专业术语。

sents.en: The authors should reflect on the factors that influence the performance of the approach.
sents.zh: 作者应反思影响该方法性能的因素。

sents.en: For example, a facial recognition algorithm may perform poorly when image resolution is low or images are taken in low lighting.
sents.zh: 例如，当图像分辨率较低或图像在低光照条件下拍摄时，人脸识别算法的性能可能会很差。

sents.en: Or a speech-to-text system might not be used reliably to provide closed captions for online lectures because it fails to handle technical jargon.
sents.zh: 或者，语音转文字系统可能无法可靠地用于为在线课程提供字幕，因为它无法处理专业术语。

paragraphs.en: The authors should discuss the computational efficiency of the proposed algorithms and how they scale with dataset size.
paragraphs.zh: 作者应讨论所提出算法的计算效率，以及它们如何随着数据集规模的增大而扩展。

paragraphs.en: If applicable, the authors should discuss possible limitations of their approach to address problems of privacy and fairness.
paragraphs.zh: 如果适用，作者应讨论其方法可能存在的局限性，以应对隐私和公平性问题。

paragraphs.en: While the authors might fear that complete honesty about limitations might be used by reviewers as grounds for rejection, a worse outcome might be that reviewers discover limitations that aren’t acknowledged in the paper. The authors should use their best judgment and recognize that individual actions in favor of transparency play an important role in developing norms that preserve the integrity of the community. Reviewers will be specifically instructed to not penalize honesty concerning limitations.
paragraphs.zh: 尽管作者们可能担心，对研究局限性的完全坦诚会被审稿人用作拒绝论文的理由，但更糟糕的情况可能是，审稿人发现了论文中并未提及的局限性。 作者应依据自己的最佳判断行事，并认识到，为追求透明度而采取的个人行动，在形成维护学术共同体完整性的规范方面发挥着重要作用。 将特别指示审稿人不得因作者坦诚说明研究局限性而对其进行惩罚。

sents.en: While the authors might fear that complete honesty about limitations might be used by reviewers as grounds for rejection, a worse outcome might be that reviewers discover limitations that aren’t acknowledged in the paper.
sents.zh: 尽管作者们可能担心，对研究局限性的完全坦诚会被审稿人用作拒绝论文的理由，但更糟糕的情况可能是，审稿人发现了论文中并未提及的局限性。

sents.en: The authors should use their best judgment and recognize that individual actions in favor of transparency play an important role in developing norms that preserve the integrity of the community.
sents.zh: 作者应依据自己的最佳判断行事，并认识到，为追求透明度而采取的个人行动，在形成维护学术共同体完整性的规范方面发挥着重要作用。

sents.zh: 将特别指示审稿人不得因作者坦诚说明研究局限性而对其进行惩罚。

paragraphs.en: Question: For each theoretical result, does the paper provide the full set of assumptions and a complete (and correct) proof?
paragraphs.zh: 问题：对于每一项理论性结果，该论文是否提供了完整的假设集合以及完整（且正确）的证明？

paragraphs.en: Justification: The paper proposes an empirical retrieval framework and does not claim theoretical results requiring formal proofs.
paragraphs.zh: 理由：本文提出了一种经验性检索框架，并未声称需要形式化证明的理论结果。

paragraphs.en: The answer [N/A] means that the paper does not include theoretical results.
paragraphs.zh: 答案 [N/A] 表示该论文不包含理论性结果。

paragraphs.en: All the theorems, formulas, and proofs in the paper should be numbered and cross-referenced.
paragraphs.zh: 论文中的所有定理、公式和证明都应编号并进行交叉引用。

paragraphs.en: All assumptions should be clearly stated or referenced in the statement of any theorems.
paragraphs.zh: 所有假设都应在任何定理的陈述中明确说明或引用。

paragraphs.en: The proofs can either appear in the main paper or the supplemental material, but if they appear in the supplemental material, the authors are encouraged to provide a short proof sketch to provide intuition.
paragraphs.zh: 证明可以出现在主论文或补充材料中，但如果出现在补充材料中，建议作者提供一个简短的证明概要，以帮助读者理解其直观思路。

paragraphs.en: Inversely, any informal proof provided in the core of the paper should be complemented by formal proofs provided in appendix or supplemental material.
paragraphs.zh: 反之，论文核心部分提供的任何非正式证明，都应由附录或补充材料中提供的正式证明加以补充。

paragraphs.en: Theorems and Lemmas that the proof relies upon should be properly referenced.
paragraphs.zh: 证明所依赖的定理和引理应得到适当的引用。

paragraphs.en: Question: Does the paper fully disclose all the information needed to reproduce the main experimental results of the paper to the extent that it affects the main claims and/or conclusions of the paper (regardless of whether the code and data are provided or not)?
paragraphs.zh: 问题：本文是否完整披露了重现其主要实验结果所需的所有信息，且这些信息对本文的主要论点和/或结论具有影响（无论代码和数据是否已提供）？

paragraphs.en: Justification: Sections 4.1 – 4.2 and Appendices A , B , C , and J describe the datasets, splits, memory-pool construction, training procedure, hyperparameters, prompts, and evaluation protocol needed to reproduce the main results. The supplementary Markdown guide and anonymized code package provide executable scripts and configuration files for reproducing the main results.
paragraphs.zh: 理由：第 4.1 – 4.2 节以及附录 A、B、C 和 J 描述了重现主要结果所需的数据集、数据划分、内存池构建、训练流程、超参数、提示词和评估协议。 补充的 Markdown 指南和匿名化代码包提供了用于重现主要结果的可用脚本和配置文件。

sents.en: Justification: Sections 4.1 – 4.2 and Appendices A , B , C , and J describe the datasets, splits, memory-pool construction, training procedure, hyperparameters, prompts, and evaluation protocol needed to reproduce the main results.
sents.zh: 理由：第 4.1 – 4.2 节以及附录 A、B、C 和 J 描述了重现主要结果所需的数据集、数据划分、内存池构建、训练流程、超参数、提示词和评估协议。

sents.en: The supplementary Markdown guide and anonymized code package provide executable scripts and configuration files for reproducing the main results.
sents.zh: 补充的 Markdown 指南和匿名化代码包提供了用于重现主要结果的可用脚本和配置文件。

paragraphs.en: The answer [N/A] means that the paper does not include experiments.
paragraphs.zh: 答案 [N/A] 表示该论文未包含实验。

paragraphs.en: If the paper includes experiments, a [No] answer to this question will not be perceived well by the reviewers: Making the paper reproducible is important, regardless of whether the code and data are provided or not.
paragraphs.zh: 如果论文包含实验，那么对这个问题回答 [否] 将不会给审稿人留下好印象：无论是否提供了代码和数据，使论文具有可重复性都至关重要。

paragraphs.en: If the contribution is a dataset and/or model, the authors should describe the steps taken to make their results reproducible or verifiable.
paragraphs.zh: 如果贡献内容是一个数据集和/或模型，作者应描述为使结果具有可重复性或可验证性而采取的步骤。

paragraphs.en: Depending on the contribution, reproducibility can be accomplished in various ways. For example, if the contribution is a novel architecture, describing the architecture fully might suffice, or if the contribution is a specific model and empirical evaluation, it may be necessary to either make it possible for others to replicate the model with the same dataset, or provide access to the model. In general. releasing code and data is often one good way to accomplish this, but reproducibility can also be provided via detailed instructions for how to replicate the results, access to a hosted model (e.g., in the case of a large language model), releasing of a model checkpoint, or other means that are appropriate to the research performed.
paragraphs.zh: 根据贡献的不同，可以通过多种方式实现可重复性。 例如，如果贡献是一种新颖的架构，那么完整描述该架构可能就已足够；如果贡献是一个特定的模型和实证评估，则可能需要让他人能够使用相同的数据集复现该模型，或者提供获取该模型的途径。 通常而言，发布代码和数据往往是实现这一目标的好方法之一，但也可以通过详细说明如何复现结果的步骤、提供托管模型的访问权限（例如大型语言模型的情况）、发布模型检查点，或采用其他适合所开展研究的方式来实现可重复性。

sents.en: Depending on the contribution, reproducibility can be accomplished in various ways.
sents.zh: 根据贡献的不同，可以通过多种方式实现可重复性。

sents.en: For example, if the contribution is a novel architecture, describing the architecture fully might suffice, or if the contribution is a specific model and empirical evaluation, it may be necessary to either make it possible for others to replicate the model with the same dataset, or provide access to the model.
sents.zh: 例如，如果贡献是一种新颖的架构，那么完整描述该架构可能就已足够；如果贡献是一个特定的模型和实证评估，则可能需要让他人能够使用相同的数据集复现该模型，或者提供获取该模型的途径。

sents.en: In general. releasing code and data is often one good way to accomplish this, but reproducibility can also be provided via detailed instructions for how to replicate the results, access to a hosted model (e.g., in the case of a large language model), releasing of a model checkpoint, or other means that are appropriate to the research performed.
sents.zh: 通常而言，发布代码和数据往往是实现这一目标的好方法之一，但也可以通过详细说明如何复现结果的步骤、提供托管模型的访问权限（例如大型语言模型的情况）、发布模型检查点，或采用其他适合所开展研究的方式来实现可重复性。

paragraphs.en: While NeurIPS does not require releasing code, the conference does require all submissions to provide some reasonable avenue for reproducibility, which may depend on the nature of the contribution. For example
paragraphs.zh: 虽然 NeurIPS 不强制要求公开代码，但会议确实要求所有投稿提供某种合理的可复现途径，具体方式可能取决于贡献的性质。例如：

paragraphs.en: If the contribution is primarily a new algorithm, the paper should make it clear how to reproduce that algorithm.
paragraphs.zh: 如果该贡献主要是一项新算法，论文应明确说明如何复现该算法。

paragraphs.en: If the contribution is primarily a new model architecture, the paper should describe the architecture clearly and fully.
paragraphs.zh: 如果该贡献主要是一种新的模型架构，论文应清晰且完整地描述该架构。

paragraphs.en: If the contribution is a new model (e.g., a large language model), then there should either be a way to access this model for reproducing the results or a way to reproduce the model (e.g., with an open-source dataset or instructions for how to construct the dataset).
paragraphs.zh: 如果该贡献是一项新模型（例如，一个大语言模型），那么应当提供一种访问该模型以复现结果的方法，或者提供复现该模型的方法（例如，使用开源数据集或构建该数据集的说明）。

paragraphs.en: We recognize that reproducibility may be tricky in some cases, in which case authors are welcome to describe the particular way they provide for reproducibility. In the case of closed-source models, it may be that access to the model is limited in some way (e.g., to registered users), but it should be possible for other researchers to have some path to reproducing or verifying the results.
paragraphs.zh: 我们认识到，在某些情况下，可重复性可能颇具挑战；在这种情况下，作者可以描述他们确保可重复性的具体方法。 对于闭源模型，其访问权限可能在某些方面受到限制（例如，仅限注册用户），但其他研究人员仍应能够以某种方式复现或验证研究结果。

sents.en: We recognize that reproducibility may be tricky in some cases, in which case authors are welcome to describe the particular way they provide for reproducibility.
sents.zh: 我们认识到，在某些情况下，可重复性可能颇具挑战；在这种情况下，作者可以描述他们确保可重复性的具体方法。

sents.en: In the case of closed-source models, it may be that access to the model is limited in some way (e.g., to registered users), but it should be possible for other researchers to have some path to reproducing or verifying the results.
sents.zh: 对于闭源模型，其访问权限可能在某些方面受到限制（例如，仅限注册用户），但其他研究人员仍应能够以某种方式复现或验证研究结果。

paragraphs.en: Question: Does the paper provide open access to the data and code, with sufficient instructions to faithfully reproduce the main experimental results, as described in supplemental material?
paragraphs.zh: 问题：论文是否对数据和代码提供了开放获取，并附有足以忠实复现主要实验结果的说明（如补充材料所述）？

paragraphs.en: Justification: We provide an anonymized supplementary code package with a Markdown reproduction guide, including environment setup, data preparation instructions, configuration files, and scripts for reproducing the main experiments.
paragraphs.zh: 说明：我们提供了一个匿名化的补充代码包，其中包含 Markdown 格式的复现指南，涵盖环境搭建、数据准备说明、配置文件以及用于复现主要实验的脚本。

paragraphs.en: The answer [N/A] means that paper does not include experiments requiring code.
paragraphs.zh: 答案 [N/A] 表示该论文不包含需要代码的实验。

paragraphs.en: Please see the NeurIPS code and data submission guidelines ( https://neurips.cc/public/guides/CodeSubmissionPolicy ) for more details.
paragraphs.zh: 有关更多详细信息，请参阅 NeurIPS 的代码和数据提交指南（https://neurips.cc/public/guides/CodeSubmissionPolicy）。

paragraphs.en: While we encourage the release of code and data, we understand that this might not be possible, so [No] is an acceptable answer. Papers cannot be rejected simply for not including code, unless this is central to the contribution (e.g., for a new open-source benchmark).
paragraphs.zh: 虽然我们鼓励发布代码和数据，但我们理解这可能并非可行，因此选择 [否] 也是可以接受的答案。 论文不能仅仅因为没有包含代码而被拒绝，除非代码是贡献的核心部分（例如，针对一个新的开源基准测试）。

sents.en: While we encourage the release of code and data, we understand that this might not be possible, so [No] is an acceptable answer.
sents.zh: 虽然我们鼓励发布代码和数据，但我们理解这可能并非可行，因此选择 [否] 也是可以接受的答案。

sents.en: Papers cannot be rejected simply for not including code, unless this is central to the contribution (e.g., for a new open-source benchmark).
sents.zh: 论文不能仅仅因为没有包含代码而被拒绝，除非代码是贡献的核心部分（例如，针对一个新的开源基准测试）。

paragraphs.en: The instructions should contain the exact command and environment needed to run to reproduce the results. See the NeurIPS code and data submission guidelines ( https://neurips.cc/public/guides/CodeSubmissionPolicy ) for more details.
paragraphs.zh: 说明中应包含运行所需的确切命令和环境，以便重现结果。 更多详情请参阅 NeurIPS 的代码和数据提交指南（https://neurips.cc/public/guides/CodeSubmissionPolicy）。

sents.en: The instructions should contain the exact command and environment needed to run to reproduce the results.
sents.zh: 说明中应包含运行所需的确切命令和环境，以便重现结果。

sents.en: See the NeurIPS code and data submission guidelines ( https://neurips.cc/public/guides/CodeSubmissionPolicy ) for more details.
sents.zh: 更多详情请参阅 NeurIPS 的代码和数据提交指南（https://neurips.cc/public/guides/CodeSubmissionPolicy）。

paragraphs.en: The authors should provide instructions on data access and preparation, including how to access the raw data, preprocessed data, intermediate data, and generated data, etc.
paragraphs.zh: 作者应提供有关数据访问和准备的说明，包括如何获取原始数据、预处理数据、中间数据和生成数据等。

paragraphs.en: The authors should provide scripts to reproduce all experimental results for the new proposed method and baselines. If only a subset of experiments are reproducible, they should state which ones are omitted from the script and why.
paragraphs.zh: 作者应提供脚本，以便复现新提出方法以及基线方法的所有实验结果。 如果仅有一部分实验可以复现，他们应说明哪些实验未被包含在脚本中及其原因。

sents.en: The authors should provide scripts to reproduce all experimental results for the new proposed method and baselines.
sents.zh: 作者应提供脚本，以便复现新提出方法以及基线方法的所有实验结果。

sents.en: If only a subset of experiments are reproducible, they should state which ones are omitted from the script and why.
sents.zh: 如果仅有一部分实验可以复现，他们应说明哪些实验未被包含在脚本中及其原因。

paragraphs.en: At submission time, to preserve anonymity, the authors should release anonymized versions (if applicable).
paragraphs.zh: 提交时，为保持匿名性，作者应发布经过匿名处理的版本（如适用）。

paragraphs.en: Providing as much information as possible in supplemental material (appended to the paper) is recommended, but including URLs to data and code is permitted.
paragraphs.zh: 建议在补充材料（附于论文之后）中尽可能提供更多信息，但也可以包含数据和代码的 URL。

paragraphs.en: Question: Does the paper specify all the training and test details (e.g., data splits, hyperparameters, how they were chosen, type of optimizer) necessary to understand the results?
paragraphs.zh: 问题：该论文是否说明了理解研究结果所需的所有训练和测试细节（例如，数据划分、超参数及其选择方式、优化器类型）？

paragraphs.en: Justification: Section 4.2 specifies datasets, baselines, retrieval budget, model choices, split construction, and key hyperparameters; Appendix C gives SFT and GRPO training details, and Appendix E details baseline adaptation. The supplementary code package includes the corresponding configuration files and run scripts.
paragraphs.zh: 理由：第 4.2 节规定了数据集、基线模型、检索预算、模型选择、数据划分构建以及关键超参数；附录 C 提供了 SFT 和 GRPO 的训练细节，附录 E 则详细说明了基线模型的适配方法。 补充代码包包含相应的配置文件和运行脚本。

sents.en: Justification: Section 4.2 specifies datasets, baselines, retrieval budget, model choices, split construction, and key hyperparameters; Appendix C gives SFT and GRPO training details, and Appendix E details baseline adaptation.
sents.zh: 理由：第 4.2 节规定了数据集、基线模型、检索预算、模型选择、数据划分构建以及关键超参数；附录 C 提供了 SFT 和 GRPO 的训练细节，附录 E 则详细说明了基线模型的适配方法。

sents.en: The supplementary code package includes the corresponding configuration files and run scripts.
sents.zh: 补充代码包包含相应的配置文件和运行脚本。

paragraphs.en: The experimental setting should be presented in the core of the paper to a level of detail that is necessary to appreciate the results and make sense of them.
paragraphs.zh: 实验设置应在论文的核心部分以足够的细节呈现，以便读者能够理解并正确解读研究结果。

paragraphs.en: The full details can be provided either with the code, in appendix, or as supplemental material.
paragraphs.zh: 完整细节可以通过代码、附录或补充材料提供。

paragraphs.en: Question: Does the paper report error bars suitably and correctly defined or other appropriate information about the statistical significance of the experiments?
paragraphs.zh: 问题：该论文是否恰当且正确地报告了误差棒，或提供了关于实验统计显著性的其他适当信息？

paragraphs.en: Justification: The main result tables report means and standard deviations over independent evaluation runs, and Appendix F reports stratified accuracy with standard deviations.
paragraphs.zh: 理由：主要结果表报告了独立评估运行中的均值和标准差，而附录 F 则报告了分层准确率及其标准差。

paragraphs.en: The authors should answer [Yes] if the results are accompanied by error bars, confidence intervals, or statistical significance tests, at least for the experiments that support the main claims of the paper.
paragraphs.zh: 如果研究结果附有误差棒、置信区间或统计显著性检验（至少对于支持论文主要论点的实验而言），作者应选择[是]。

paragraphs.en: The factors of variability that the error bars are capturing should be clearly stated (for example, train/test split, initialization, random drawing of some parameter, or overall run with given experimental conditions).
paragraphs.zh: 误差棒所反映的变异性因素应明确说明（例如，训练/测试划分、初始化、某些参数的随机抽取，或在给定实验条件下的整体运行）。

paragraphs.en: The method for calculating the error bars should be explained (closed form formula, call to a library function, bootstrap, etc.)
paragraphs.zh: 应说明误差棒的计算方法（闭式公式、调用库函数、自助法等）。

paragraphs.en: The assumptions made should be given (e.g., Normally distributed errors).
paragraphs.zh: 所采用的假设应予以说明（例如，误差服从正态分布）。

paragraphs.en: It should be clear whether the error bar is the standard deviation or the standard error of the mean.
paragraphs.zh: 应当明确误差棒代表的是标准差还是均值的标准误。

paragraphs.en: It is OK to report 1-sigma error bars, but one should state it. The authors should preferably report a 2-sigma error bar than state that they have a 96% CI, if the hypothesis of Normality of errors is not verified.
paragraphs.zh: 报告 1-σ 误差棒是可以的，但应当明确说明这一点。 如果未验证误差的正态性假设，作者最好报告 2-σ 误差棒，而不是声称其置信区间为 96%。

sents.en: It is OK to report 1-sigma error bars, but one should state it.
sents.zh: 报告 1-σ 误差棒是可以的，但应当明确说明这一点。

sents.en: The authors should preferably report a 2-sigma error bar than state that they have a 96% CI, if the hypothesis of Normality of errors is not verified.
sents.zh: 如果未验证误差的正态性假设，作者最好报告 2-σ 误差棒，而不是声称其置信区间为 96%。

paragraphs.en: For asymmetric distributions, the authors should be careful not to show in tables or figures symmetric error bars that would yield results that are out of range (e.g., negative error rates).
paragraphs.zh: 对于非对称分布，作者应谨慎避免在表格或图表中展示对称误差棒，因为这可能导致结果超出合理范围（例如，出现负的错误率）。

paragraphs.en: If error bars are reported in tables or plots, the authors should explain in the text how they were calculated and reference the corresponding figures or tables in the text.
paragraphs.zh: 如果表格或图表中报告了误差棒，作者应在正文中解释其计算方法，并在正文中引用相应的图表。

paragraphs.en: Question: For each experiment, does the paper provide sufficient information on the computer resources (type of compute workers, memory, time of execution) needed to reproduce the experiments?
paragraphs.zh: 问题：对于每次实验，该论文是否提供了足够的信息，说明重现这些实验所需的计算资源（计算智能体的类型、内存、执行时间）？

paragraphs.en: Justification: Appendix H reports training hardware, wall-clock cost, and the per-query inference latency.
paragraphs.zh: 理由：附录 H 报告了训练硬件、实际运行成本以及每次查询的推理延迟。

paragraphs.en: The paper should indicate the type of compute workers CPU or GPU, internal cluster, or cloud provider, including relevant memory and storage.
paragraphs.zh: 论文中应说明计算工作器的类型（CPU 或 GPU）、内部集群或云提供商，并包含相关的内存和存储信息。

paragraphs.en: The paper should provide the amount of compute required for each of the individual experimental runs as well as estimate the total compute.
paragraphs.zh: 该论文应说明每次单独实验运行所需的计算量，并估算总计算量。

paragraphs.en: The paper should disclose whether the full research project required more compute than the experiments reported in the paper (e.g., preliminary or failed experiments that didn’t make it into the paper).
paragraphs.zh: 论文应说明整个研究项目所需的计算资源是否多于论文中报告的那些实验（例如，未纳入论文的初步实验或失败实验）。

paragraphs.en: Question: Does the research conducted in the paper conform, in every respect, with the NeurIPS Code of Ethics https://neurips.cc/public/EthicsGuidelines ?
paragraphs.zh: 问题：该论文中开展的研究是否在各方面均符合 NeurIPS 道德准则 https://neurips.cc/public/EthicsGuidelines？

paragraphs.en: Justification: The work uses synthetic benchmarks and does not use real personal-memory data; privacy and misuse risks are discussed in Appendix I.2 . The submission is anonymized and does not disclose identifying author information.
paragraphs.zh: 理由：该研究使用了合成基准测试，并未使用真实的个人记忆数据；隐私和滥用风险已在附录 I.2 中进行了讨论。 提交内容已匿名化处理，未披露任何可识别作者身份的信息。

sents.en: Justification: The work uses synthetic benchmarks and does not use real personal-memory data; privacy and misuse risks are discussed in Appendix I.2 .
sents.zh: 理由：该研究使用了合成基准测试，并未使用真实的个人记忆数据；隐私和滥用风险已在附录 I.2 中进行了讨论。

sents.en: The submission is anonymized and does not disclose identifying author information.
sents.zh: 提交内容已匿名化处理，未披露任何可识别作者身份的信息。

paragraphs.en: The answer [N/A] means that the authors have not reviewed the NeurIPS Code of Ethics.
paragraphs.zh: 答案 [N/A] 表示作者尚未审阅 NeurIPS 道德准则。

paragraphs.en: If the authors answer [No] , they should explain the special circumstances that require a deviation from the Code of Ethics.
paragraphs.zh: 如果作者回答[否]，他们应解释需要偏离《道德准则》的特殊情况。

paragraphs.en: The authors should make sure to preserve anonymity (e.g., if there is a special consideration due to laws or regulations in their jurisdiction).
paragraphs.zh: 作者应确保保持匿名性（例如，如果其司法管辖区的法律或法规存在特殊考量）。

paragraphs.en: Question: Does the paper discuss both potential positive societal impacts and negative societal impacts of the work performed?
paragraphs.zh: 问题：该论文是否讨论了所开展工作可能带来的积极社会影响和消极社会影响？

paragraphs.en: Justification: Appendix I.2 discusses positive impacts for long-term personalized assistants as well as risks from fabricated dates, biased extraction, and propagation of upstream memory errors.
paragraphs.zh: 理由：附录 I.2 讨论了长期个性化助手带来的积极影响，以及虚构日期、有偏见的提取和上游记忆错误传播所带来的风险。

paragraphs.en: The answer [N/A] means that there is no societal impact of the work performed.
paragraphs.zh: 答案 [N/A] 表示所完成的工作对社会没有影响。

paragraphs.en: If the authors answer [N/A] or [No] , they should explain why their work has no societal impact or why the paper does not address societal impact.
paragraphs.zh: 如果作者回答 [N/A] 或 [否]，他们应解释其工作为何没有社会影响，或该论文为何未涉及社会影响。

paragraphs.en: Examples of negative societal impacts include potential malicious or unintended uses (e.g., disinformation, generating fake profiles, surveillance), fairness considerations (e.g., deployment of technologies that could make decisions that unfairly impact specific groups), privacy considerations, and security considerations.
paragraphs.zh: 负面社会影响的示例包括潜在的恶意或无意用途（例如，虚假信息、生成虚假个人资料、监控）、公平性考量（例如，部署可能对特定群体造成不公平影响的技术决策）、隐私考量以及安全考量。

paragraphs.en: The conference expects that many papers will be foundational research and not tied to particular applications, let alone deployments. However, if there is a direct path to any negative applications, the authors should point it out. For example, it is legitimate to point out that an improvement in the quality of generative models could be used to generate Deepfakes for disinformation. On the other hand, it is not needed to point out that a generic algorithm for optimizing neural networks could enable people to train models that generate Deepfakes faster.
paragraphs.zh: 本次会议期望许多论文都将属于基础性研究，而非与特定应用挂钩，更不用说实际部署了。 然而，如果存在任何可能导致负面应用的直接路径，作者应当指出这一点。 例如，指出生成式模型质量的提升可能被用于制造虚假信息中的深度伪造内容，这一观点是合理的。 另一方面，则无需指出一种通用的神经网络优化算法可能使人们能够更快地训练出可生成深度伪造内容的模型。

sents.en: The conference expects that many papers will be foundational research and not tied to particular applications, let alone deployments.
sents.zh: 本次会议期望许多论文都将属于基础性研究，而非与特定应用挂钩，更不用说实际部署了。

sents.en: However, if there is a direct path to any negative applications, the authors should point it out.
sents.zh: 然而，如果存在任何可能导致负面应用的直接路径，作者应当指出这一点。

sents.en: For example, it is legitimate to point out that an improvement in the quality of generative models could be used to generate Deepfakes for disinformation.
sents.zh: 例如，指出生成式模型质量的提升可能被用于制造虚假信息中的深度伪造内容，这一观点是合理的。

sents.en: On the other hand, it is not needed to point out that a generic algorithm for optimizing neural networks could enable people to train models that generate Deepfakes faster.
sents.zh: 另一方面，则无需指出一种通用的神经网络优化算法可能使人们能够更快地训练出可生成深度伪造内容的模型。

paragraphs.en: The authors should consider possible harms that could arise when the technology is being used as intended and functioning correctly, harms that could arise when the technology is being used as intended but gives incorrect results, and harms following from (intentional or unintentional) misuse of the technology.
paragraphs.zh: 作者应考虑该技术按预期使用且正常运行时可能产生的危害、该技术按预期使用但给出错误结果时可能产生的危害，以及因（有意或无意）滥用该技术而导致的危害。

paragraphs.en: If there are negative societal impacts, the authors could also discuss possible mitigation strategies (e.g., gated release of models, providing defenses in addition to attacks, mechanisms for monitoring misuse, mechanisms to monitor how a system learns from feedback over time, improving the efficiency and accessibility of ML).
paragraphs.zh: 如果存在负面社会影响，作者还可以讨论可能的缓解策略（例如，对模型进行限制性发布、在提供攻击方法的同时提供防御措施、建立滥用行为监测机制、建立监测系统随时间从反馈中学习方式的机制，以及提升机器学习技术的效率和可及性）。

paragraphs.en: Question: Does the paper describe safeguards that have been put in place for responsible release of data or models that have a high risk for misuse (e.g., pre-trained language models, image generators, or scraped datasets)?
paragraphs.zh: 问题：该论文是否描述了为确保数据或模型负责任地发布而采取的安全措施？这些数据或模型存在被滥用的较高风险（例如，预训练语言模型、图像生成器或网络爬取的数据集）。

paragraphs.en: Justification: The paper does not release a high-risk foundation model, scraped dataset, image generator, or real personal-memory corpus. As an experimental safeguard, all training and evaluation use synthetic benchmarks.
paragraphs.zh: 理由：该论文并未发布高风险的基础模型、抓取的数据集、图像生成器或真实的个人记忆语料库。 作为实验性保障措施，所有训练和评估均使用合成基准数据集。

sents.en: Justification: The paper does not release a high-risk foundation model, scraped dataset, image generator, or real personal-memory corpus.
sents.zh: 理由：该论文并未发布高风险的基础模型、抓取的数据集、图像生成器或真实的个人记忆语料库。

sents.en: As an experimental safeguard, all training and evaluation use synthetic benchmarks.
sents.zh: 作为实验性保障措施，所有训练和评估均使用合成基准数据集。

paragraphs.en: The answer [N/A] means that the paper poses no such risks.
paragraphs.zh: 答案 [N/A] 表示该论文不存在此类风险。

paragraphs.en: Released models that have a high risk for misuse or dual-use should be released with necessary safeguards to allow for controlled use of the model, for example by requiring that users adhere to usage guidelines or restrictions to access the model or implementing safety filters.
paragraphs.zh: 对于存在较高滥用或双重用途风险已发布的模型，应配备必要的安全保障措施，以实现对该模型的受控使用。例如，可以要求用户遵守使用指南或限制才能访问该模型，或者实施安全过滤器。

paragraphs.en: Datasets that have been scraped from the Internet could pose safety risks. The authors should describe how they avoided releasing unsafe images.
paragraphs.zh: 从互联网上抓取的数据集可能会带来安全风险。 作者应说明他们如何避免发布不安全的图像。

sents.en: Datasets that have been scraped from the Internet could pose safety risks.
sents.zh: 从互联网上抓取的数据集可能会带来安全风险。

sents.en: The authors should describe how they avoided releasing unsafe images.
sents.zh: 作者应说明他们如何避免发布不安全的图像。

paragraphs.en: We recognize that providing effective safeguards is challenging, and many papers do not require this, but we encourage authors to take this into account and make a best faith effort.
paragraphs.zh: 我们认识到，提供有效的保障措施具有挑战性，许多论文也并未提出这一要求，但我们鼓励作者将此纳入考量，并尽最大努力予以实现。

paragraphs.en: Question: Are the creators or original owners of assets (e.g., code, data, models), used in the paper, properly credited and are the license and terms of use explicitly mentioned and properly respected?
paragraphs.zh: 问题：论文中使用的资产（例如代码、数据、模型）的创建者或原始所有者是否得到了适当的署名？其许可证和使用条款是否被明确提及并得到妥善遵守？

paragraphs.en: Justification: Existing assets used in the paper, including LifeBench, LoCoMo, Qwen3-1.7B, BGE-M3, BM25, veRL, and API-based LLMs, are credited through citations in the paper. The supplementary Markdown guide lists their project links, versions when available, and license or terms-of-use information, and our use follows those terms.
paragraphs.zh: 理由：论文中使用的现有资产，包括 LifeBench、LoCoMo、Qwen3-1.7B、BGE-M3、BM25、veRL 和基于 API 的大型语言模型，均已通过论文中的引用予以注明。 补充的 Markdown 指南列出了这些项目的相关链接、可用版本以及许可或使用条款信息，我们的使用遵循了这些条款。

sents.en: Justification: Existing assets used in the paper, including LifeBench, LoCoMo, Qwen3-1.7B, BGE-M3, BM25, veRL, and API-based LLMs, are credited through citations in the paper.
sents.zh: 理由：论文中使用的现有资产，包括 LifeBench、LoCoMo、Qwen3-1.7B、BGE-M3、BM25、veRL 和基于 API 的大型语言模型，均已通过论文中的引用予以注明。

sents.en: The supplementary Markdown guide lists their project links, versions when available, and license or terms-of-use information, and our use follows those terms.
sents.zh: 补充的 Markdown 指南列出了这些项目的相关链接、可用版本以及许可或使用条款信息，我们的使用遵循了这些条款。

paragraphs.en: The answer [N/A] means that the paper does not use existing assets.
paragraphs.zh: 答案 [N/A] 表示该论文未使用现有资产。

paragraphs.en: The authors should cite the original paper that produced the code package or dataset.
paragraphs.zh: 作者应引用生成该代码包或数据集的原始论文。

paragraphs.en: The authors should state which version of the asset is used and, if possible, include a URL.
paragraphs.zh: 作者应说明使用了哪个版本的资产，并在可能的情况下附上一个 URL。

paragraphs.en: The name of the license (e.g., CC-BY 4.0) should be included for each asset.
paragraphs.zh: 每个资产都应包含许可证的名称（例如，CC-BY 4.0）。

paragraphs.en: For scraped data from a particular source (e.g., website), the copyright and terms of service of that source should be provided.
paragraphs.zh: 对于从特定来源（例如网站）抓取的数据，应提供该来源的版权和条款与条件。

paragraphs.en: If assets are released, the license, copyright information, and terms of use in the package should be provided. For popular datasets, paperswithcode.com/datasets has curated licenses for some datasets. Their licensing guide can help determine the license of a dataset.
paragraphs.zh: 如果发布资产，则应提供包中的许可证、版权信息和使用条款。 对于热门数据集，paperswithcode.com/datasets 已为部分数据集整理了许可证。 他们的许可指南可以帮助确定数据集的许可证。

sents.en: If assets are released, the license, copyright information, and terms of use in the package should be provided.
sents.zh: 如果发布资产，则应提供包中的许可证、版权信息和使用条款。

sents.en: For popular datasets, paperswithcode.com/datasets has curated licenses for some datasets.
sents.zh: 对于热门数据集，paperswithcode.com/datasets 已为部分数据集整理了许可证。

sents.en: Their licensing guide can help determine the license of a dataset.
sents.zh: 他们的许可指南可以帮助确定数据集的许可证。

paragraphs.en: For existing datasets that are re-packaged, both the original license and the license of the derived asset (if it has changed) should be provided.
paragraphs.zh: 对于经过重新打包的现有数据集，应同时提供原始许可证和衍生资产的许可证（如果已变更）。

paragraphs.en: If this information is not available online, the authors are encouraged to reach out to the asset’s creators.
paragraphs.zh: 如果这些信息在网上无法获取，建议作者联系该资产的创作者。

paragraphs.en: Question: Are new assets introduced in the paper well documented and is the documentation provided alongside the assets?
paragraphs.zh: 问题：论文中引入的新资产是否得到了充分说明？提供的文档是否与这些资产一同给出？

paragraphs.en: Justification: We introduce an anonymized supplementary code package as a new asset. It is documented with a Markdown guide describing its purpose, setup, reproduction commands, dependencies, and license.
paragraphs.zh: 理由：我们引入一个匿名化的补充代码包作为新的资产。 该代码包附有 Markdown 指南，其中描述了其用途、设置、复现命令、依赖项和许可证。

sents.en: Justification: We introduce an anonymized supplementary code package as a new asset.
sents.zh: 理由：我们引入一个匿名化的补充代码包作为新的资产。

sents.en: It is documented with a Markdown guide describing its purpose, setup, reproduction commands, dependencies, and license.
sents.zh: 该代码包附有 Markdown 指南，其中描述了其用途、设置、复现命令、依赖项和许可证。

paragraphs.en: The answer [N/A] means that the paper does not release new assets.
paragraphs.zh: 答案 [N/A] 表示该论文并未发布新的资产。

paragraphs.en: Researchers should communicate the details of the dataset/code/model as part of their submissions via structured templates. This includes details about training, license, limitations, etc.
paragraphs.zh: 研究人员应在提交成果时，通过结构化模板说明数据集、代码或模型的相关细节。 这包括训练信息、许可协议、局限性等方面的内容。

sents.en: Researchers should communicate the details of the dataset/code/model as part of their submissions via structured templates.
sents.zh: 研究人员应在提交成果时，通过结构化模板说明数据集、代码或模型的相关细节。

sents.en: This includes details about training, license, limitations, etc.
sents.zh: 这包括训练信息、许可协议、局限性等方面的内容。

paragraphs.en: The paper should discuss whether and how consent was obtained from people whose asset is used.
paragraphs.zh: 论文应讨论是否以及如何从其资产被使用的人那里获得了同意。

paragraphs.en: At submission time, remember to anonymize your assets (if applicable). You can either create an anonymized URL or include an anonymized zip file.
paragraphs.zh: 提交时，请记得对您的资产进行匿名化处理（如适用）。 您可以创建一个匿名化 URL，或者附上一个经过匿名处理的压缩文件。

sents.en: At submission time, remember to anonymize your assets (if applicable).
sents.zh: 提交时，请记得对您的资产进行匿名化处理（如适用）。

sents.en: You can either create an anonymized URL or include an anonymized zip file.
sents.zh: 您可以创建一个匿名化 URL，或者附上一个经过匿名处理的压缩文件。

paragraphs.en: Crowdsourcing and research with human subjects
paragraphs.zh: 众包与涉及人类受试者的研究

paragraphs.en: Question: For crowdsourcing experiments and research with human subjects, does the paper include the full text of instructions given to participants and screenshots, if applicable, as well as details about compensation (if any)?
paragraphs.zh: 问题：对于涉及人类受试者的众包实验和研究，该论文是否包含了提供给参与者的完整说明文本以及（如适用）的屏幕截图，同时还说明了补偿细节（如有）？

paragraphs.en: Justification: The work does not conduct crowdsourcing experiments or human-subject studies. The only human involvement described is verification of synthetic benchmark-derived temporal labels, not collection of human-subject data.
paragraphs.zh: 理由：该研究未进行众包实验或涉及人类受试者的研究。 文中唯一提及的人类参与行为是验证通过合成基准生成的时间标签，而非收集人类受试者的数据。

sents.en: Justification: The work does not conduct crowdsourcing experiments or human-subject studies.
sents.zh: 理由：该研究未进行众包实验或涉及人类受试者的研究。

sents.en: The only human involvement described is verification of synthetic benchmark-derived temporal labels, not collection of human-subject data.
sents.zh: 文中唯一提及的人类参与行为是验证通过合成基准生成的时间标签，而非收集人类受试者的数据。

paragraphs.en: The answer [N/A] means that the paper does not involve crowdsourcing nor research with human subjects.
paragraphs.zh: 答案 [N/A] 表示该论文既不涉及众包，也不涉及以人类为对象的研究。

paragraphs.en: Including this information in the supplemental material is fine, but if the main contribution of the paper involves human subjects, then as much detail as possible should be included in the main paper.
paragraphs.zh: 将此类信息包含在补充材料中是可以的，但如果论文的主要贡献涉及人类受试者，则应在主文中尽可能详细地说明。

paragraphs.en: According to the NeurIPS Code of Ethics, workers involved in data collection, curation, or other labor should be paid at least the minimum wage in the country of the data collector.
paragraphs.zh: 根据 NeurIPS 道德准则，参与数据收集、整理或其他劳动的工作人员，其薪酬应至少达到数据收集者所在国家的最低工资标准。

paragraphs.en: Institutional review board (IRB) approvals or equivalent for research with human subjects
paragraphs.zh: 涉及人类受试者的研究须获得机构审查委员会（IRB）批准或同等批准

paragraphs.en: Question: Does the paper describe potential risks incurred by study participants, whether such risks were disclosed to the subjects, and whether Institutional Review Board (IRB) approvals (or an equivalent approval/review based on the requirements of your country or institution) were obtained?
paragraphs.zh: 问题：该论文是否描述了研究参与者可能面临的风险？这些风险是否已向受试者披露？是否获得了机构审查委员会（IRB）的批准（或根据您所在国家/地区或机构的要求获得的同等批准/审查）？

paragraphs.en: Justification: The paper does not involve human-subject research or real personal-memory data, so IRB approval is not applicable.
paragraphs.zh: 理由：本文不涉及人类受试者研究或真实的个人记忆数据，因此无需获得机构审查委员会（IRB）的批准。

paragraphs.en: Depending on the country in which research is conducted, IRB approval (or equivalent) may be required for any human subjects research. If you obtained IRB approval, you should clearly state this in the paper.
paragraphs.zh: 研究所在哪个国家，可能就需要针对任何涉及人类受试者的研究获得伦理审查委员会（IRB）的批准（或同等批准）。 如果你获得了伦理审查委员会（IRB）的批准，就应该在论文中明确说明这一点。

sents.en: Depending on the country in which research is conducted, IRB approval (or equivalent) may be required for any human subjects research.
sents.zh: 研究所在哪个国家，可能就需要针对任何涉及人类受试者的研究获得伦理审查委员会（IRB）的批准（或同等批准）。

sents.en: If you obtained IRB approval, you should clearly state this in the paper.
sents.zh: 如果你获得了伦理审查委员会（IRB）的批准，就应该在论文中明确说明这一点。

paragraphs.en: We recognize that the procedures for this may vary significantly between institutions and locations, and we expect authors to adhere to the NeurIPS Code of Ethics and the guidelines for their institution.
paragraphs.zh: 我们认识到，相关流程可能因机构和地点的不同而存在显著差异，因此我们期望作者遵守 NeurIPS 道德准则及其所在机构的指导方针。

paragraphs.en: For initial submissions, do not include any information that would break anonymity (if applicable), such as the institution conducting the review.
paragraphs.zh: 对于初次提交的材料，请勿包含任何可能破坏匿名性的信息（如适用），例如负责评审的机构。

paragraphs.en: Question: Does the paper describe the usage of LLMs if it is an important, original, or non-standard component of the core methods in this research? Note that if the LLM is used only for writing, editing, or formatting purposes and does not impact the core methodology, scientific rigor, or originality of the research, declaration is not required.
paragraphs.zh: 问题：如果大型语言模型（LLM）是这项研究核心方法中重要、原创或非标准的组成部分，论文是否描述了其使用方式？ 请注意，如果 LLM 仅用于写作、编辑或格式调整，且未对研究的核心理论方法、科学严谨性或原创性产生影响，则无需声明。

sents.en: Question: Does the paper describe the usage of LLMs if it is an important, original, or non-standard component of the core methods in this research?
sents.zh: 问题：如果大型语言模型（LLM）是这项研究核心方法中重要、原创或非标准的组成部分，论文是否描述了其使用方式？

sents.en: Note that if the LLM is used only for writing, editing, or formatting purposes and does not impact the core methodology, scientific rigor, or originality of the research, declaration is not required.
sents.zh: 请注意，如果 LLM 仅用于写作、编辑或格式调整，且未对研究的核心理论方法、科学严谨性或原创性产生影响，则无需声明。

paragraphs.en: Justification: LLMs are core components of the method and evaluation: they are used for memory-item extraction and summarization, temporal-label construction, downstream answer generation, and LLM-based judging. These uses are described in Sections 3 – 4.2 and Appendix J .
paragraphs.zh: 理由：大型语言模型（LLM）是该方法的核心组成部分，并在评估中发挥关键作用：它们被用于记忆项提取与摘要生成、时间标签构建、下游答案生成以及基于 LLM 的判断。 这些用途在第三至 4.2 节以及附录 J 中有详细说明。

sents.en: Justification: LLMs are core components of the method and evaluation: they are used for memory-item extraction and summarization, temporal-label construction, downstream answer generation, and LLM-based judging.
sents.zh: 理由：大型语言模型（LLM）是该方法的核心组成部分，并在评估中发挥关键作用：它们被用于记忆项提取与摘要生成、时间标签构建、下游答案生成以及基于 LLM 的判断。

sents.en: These uses are described in Sections 3 – 4.2 and Appendix J .
sents.zh: 这些用途在第三至 4.2 节以及附录 J 中有详细说明。

paragraphs.en: The answer [N/A] means that the core method development in this research does not involve LLMs as any important, original, or non-standard components.
paragraphs.zh: 答案 [N/A] 表示本研究中的核心方法开发并未将 LLM 作为任何重要、原创或非标准的组成部分。

paragraphs.en: Please refer to our LLM policy in the NeurIPS handbook for what should or should not be described.
paragraphs.zh: 有关哪些内容应当或不应进行描述，请参阅 NeurIPS 手册中我们的 LLM 政策。
